`crates/opl-api/src/placement.rs`를 만든다:

```rust
//! 배치 규칙과 HA 그룹의 계산(설계 §8). 처음 놓기, HA 복구, 비우기(그리고 계획 53의 균형 조정기)가 같은
//! 조건·점수를 쓴다.
//!
//! "자리 잡은 VM"은 `spec.power == Running`이고 `spec.node`가 있는 VM이다. 마이그레이션 중이면 원본과 대상
//! (`status.migration.node`) 둘 다 차지한다. [`Assign`]이 이것을 덮어쓴다(복구 중 옮긴 VM, 함께 옮기는 묶음).

use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

use opl_types::node::Node;
use opl_types::placement::{HaGroup, PlacementRule, RuleKind};
use opl_types::vm::{PowerState, Vm};
use uuid::Uuid;

use crate::scheduler::{Inventory, node_fits};

/// 자리 덮어쓰기: VM id → 그 VM이 차지한 노드(None이면 자리 잡지 않은 것으로 본다)
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Assign(BTreeMap<Uuid, Option<Uuid>>);

impl Assign {
    /// 이 VM이 이 노드 하나에 자리 잡은 것으로 본다.
    pub fn place(&mut self, vm: Uuid, node: Uuid) {
        self.0.insert(vm, Some(node));
    }

    /// 이 VM을 자리 잡지 않은 것으로 본다.
    pub fn unplace(&mut self, vm: Uuid) {
        self.0.insert(vm, None);
    }
}

/// 이 VM이 차지한 노드
fn occupied(vm: &Vm, assign: &Assign) -> Vec<Uuid> {
    if let Some(node) = assign.0.get(&vm.id) {
        return node.iter().copied().collect();
    }
    let Some(node) = vm
        .spec
        .node
        .filter(|_| vm.spec.power == PowerState::Running)
    else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let mut nodes = vec![node];
    if let Some(m) = &vm.status.migration
        && m.node != node
    {
        nodes.push(m.node);
    }
    nodes
}

/// 놓을 수 있는 노드 하나와 그 점수
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Candidate {
    pub node: Uuid,
    /// HA 그룹에서 이 노드의 우선순위(그룹 VM만). 그룹 밖 노드와 그룹 없는 VM은 None(가장 낮음)이다.
    pub priority: Option<u32>,
    /// soft 규칙 벌점의 합
    pub penalty: u32,
    /// 실행하기로 된 다른 VM에 배정되지 않은 메모리. 계획 53이 부하 점수로 바꾼다.
    pub free_mib: i64,
}

/// 나은 후보가 앞(`Less`): 우선순위 높은 것 → 벌점 적은 것 → 메모리 많은 것 → id 작은 것
pub fn compare(a: &Candidate, b: &Candidate) -> Ordering {
    b.priority
        .cmp(&a.priority)
        .then(a.penalty.cmp(&b.penalty))
        .then(b.free_mib.cmp(&a.free_mib))
        .then(a.node.cmp(&b.node))
}

/// 가장 나은 후보
pub fn best(candidates: &[Candidate]) -> Option<Candidate> {
    candidates.iter().copied().min_by(compare)
}

/// 노드 조건([`node_fits`])에 맞고 hard 규칙을 어기지 않는 노드들(나은 것부터)
pub fn candidates(vm: &Vm, inv: &Inventory, assign: &Assign) -> Vec<Candidate> {
    let mut found: Vec<Candidate> = inv
        .nodes
        .iter()
        .filter(|n| node_fits(&vm.spec, inv, n).is_ok())
        .filter(|n| hard_violations(vm, n, inv, assign).is_empty())
        .map(|n| Candidate {
            node: n.id,
            priority: group(vm, inv).and_then(|g| g.spec.priority(&n.name)),
            penalty: soft(vm, n, inv, assign).0,
            free_mib: free_mib(vm, n, inv, assign),
        })
        .collect();
    found.sort_by(compare);
    found
}

/// VM을 이 노드에 두면 어기는 hard 규칙의 이름(이름 순). restricted HA 그룹 밖이면 `ha-group:<이름>`.
pub fn hard_violations(vm: &Vm, node: &Node, inv: &Inventory, assign: &Assign) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
    for rule in rules_of(vm, inv).filter(|r| r.spec.kind.is_hard()) {
        let broken = match rule.spec.kind {
            RuleKind::Affinity => others(vm, rule, inv, assign).any(|n| n != node.id),
            RuleKind::AntiAffinity => others(vm, rule, inv, assign).any(|n| n == node.id),
            RuleKind::NodeAffinity => !rule.spec.has_node(&node.name, &node.labels),
            RuleKind::NodeAntiAffinity => rule.spec.has_node(&node.name, &node.labels),
            _ => false,
        };
        if broken {
            names.insert(rule.name.clone());
        }
    }
    if let Some(g) = group(vm, inv)
        && g.spec.restricted
        && g.spec.priority(&node.name).is_none()
    {
        names.insert(format!("ha-group:{}", g.name));
    }
    names.into_iter().collect()
}

/// VM을 이 노드에 두면 벌점이 생기는 soft 규칙의 이름(이름 순)
pub fn soft_violations(vm: &Vm, node: &Node, inv: &Inventory, assign: &Assign) -> Vec<String> {
    soft(vm, node, inv, assign).1
}

/// soft 벌점의 합과 벌점이 생긴 규칙 이름
fn soft(vm: &Vm, node: &Node, inv: &Inventory, assign: &Assign) -> (u32, Vec<String>) {
    let mut total = 0;
    let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
    for rule in rules_of(vm, inv).filter(|r| !r.spec.kind.is_hard()) {
        let count = |on: bool| {
            others(vm, rule, inv, assign)
                .filter(|n| (*n == node.id) == on)
                .count()
        };
        let units = match rule.spec.kind {
            RuleKind::SoftAffinity => count(false),
            RuleKind::SoftAntiAffinity => count(true),
            RuleKind::SoftNodeAffinity => {
                usize::from(!rule.spec.has_node(&node.name, &node.labels))
            }
            RuleKind::SoftNodeAntiAffinity => {
                usize::from(rule.spec.has_node(&node.name, &node.labels))
            }
            _ => 0,
        };
        if units > 0 {
            total += rule.spec.weight() * units as u32;
            names.insert(rule.name.clone());
        }
    }
    (total, names.into_iter().collect())
}

/// 이 VM이 든 켜진 규칙
fn rules_of<'a>(vm: &'a Vm, inv: &'a Inventory) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a PlacementRule> {
    inv.rules
        .iter()
        .filter(move |r| r.spec.enabled && r.spec.has_vm(&vm.name, &vm.labels))
}

/// 규칙의 다른 구성원이 차지한 노드(구성원이 마이그레이션 중이면 둘)
fn others<'a>(
    vm: &'a Vm,
    rule: &'a PlacementRule,
    inv: &'a Inventory,
    assign: &'a Assign,
) -> impl Iterator<Item = Uuid> + 'a {
    inv.vms
        .iter()
        .filter(move |v| v.id != vm.id && rule.spec.has_vm(&v.name, &v.labels))
        .flat_map(move |v| occupied(v, assign))
}

/// HA 활성 VM의 HA 그룹
fn group<'a>(vm: &Vm, inv: &'a Inventory) -> Option<&'a HaGroup> {
    if !vm.spec.ha_active() {
        return None;
    }
    let name = vm.spec.ha.as_ref()?.group.as_ref()?;
    inv.groups.iter().find(|g| &g.name == name)
}

/// [`Inventory::free_memory_mib`]과 같되 [`Assign`]의 자리를 따른다.
fn free_mib(vm: &Vm, node: &Node, inv: &Inventory, assign: &Assign) -> i64 {
    let used: i64 = inv
        .vms
        .iter()
        .filter(|v| v.id != vm.id)
        .filter(|v| match assign.0.get(&v.id) {
            Some(placed) => *placed == Some(node.id),
            None => v.spec.node == Some(node.id) && v.spec.power == PowerState::Running,
        })
        .map(|v| i64::from(v.spec.memory_mib))
        .sum();
    node.status.memory_mib as i64 - used
}

/// 켜진 hard 규칙끼리의 모순(태그는 지금의 VM·노드 레이블로 푼다). 모순이 있으면 관련된 규칙 이름(이름
/// 순)이다:
/// (a) 같은 두 VM이 `affinity` 묶음(추이적)과 `anti-affinity`에 함께 있음,
/// (b) 한 `affinity` 묶음(규칙이 없는 VM은 혼자)의 허용 노드(구성원들의 `node-affinity` 교집합 −
/// `node-anti-affinity`, 위트니스 제외)가 비어 있음.
pub fn conflicts(rules: &[PlacementRule], inv: &Inventory) -> Result<(), Vec<String>> {
    let hard: Vec<&PlacementRule> = rules
        .iter()
        .filter(|r| r.spec.enabled && r.spec.kind.is_hard())
        .collect();
    let vms_of = |r: &PlacementRule| -> BTreeSet<String> {
        match &r.spec.vm_tag {
            Some(_) => inv
                .vms
                .iter()
                .filter(|v| r.spec.has_vm(&v.name, &v.labels))
                .map(|v| v.name.clone())
                .collect(),
            None => r.spec.vms.iter().cloned().collect(),
        }
    };
    let members: Vec<(&PlacementRule, BTreeSet<String>)> =
        hard.iter().map(|r| (*r, vms_of(r))).collect();

    // affinity 묶음: 이름 → 대표(union-find)
    let mut parent: BTreeMap<String, String> = BTreeMap::new();
    fn find(parent: &mut BTreeMap<String, String>, x: &str) -> String {
        let mut root = x.to_string();
        while let Some(p) = parent.get(&root).filter(|p| **p != root) {
            root = p.clone();
        }
        parent.insert(x.to_string(), root.clone());
        root
    }
    for (_, vms) in members
        .iter()
        .filter(|(r, _)| r.spec.kind == RuleKind::Affinity)
    {
        let mut it = vms.iter();
        if let Some(first) = it.next() {
            let root = find(&mut parent, first);
            for vm in it {
                let other = find(&mut parent, vm);
                parent.insert(other, root.clone());
            }
        }
    }
    // 묶음마다 그 묶음을 만든 affinity 규칙
    let mut joined: BTreeMap<String, BTreeSet<String>> = BTreeMap::new();
    for (rule, vms) in members
        .iter()
        .filter(|(r, _)| r.spec.kind == RuleKind::Affinity)
    {
        if let Some(vm) = vms.iter().next() {
            let root = find(&mut parent, vm);
            joined.entry(root).or_default().insert(rule.name.clone());
        }
    }

    let mut bad = BTreeSet::new();
    // (a)
    for (rule, vms) in members
        .iter()
        .filter(|(r, _)| r.spec.kind == RuleKind::AntiAffinity)
    {
        let mut seen: BTreeMap<String, &str> = BTreeMap::new();
        for vm in vms {
            let root = find(&mut parent, vm);
            if seen.insert(root.clone(), vm).is_some() {
                bad.insert(rule.name.clone());
                bad.extend(joined.get(&root).into_iter().flatten().cloned());
            }
        }
    }
    // (b)
    let universe: BTreeSet<&str> = inv
        .nodes
        .iter()
        .filter(|n| !n.spec.witness)
        .map(|n| n.name.as_str())
        .collect();
    let nodes_of = |r: &PlacementRule| -> BTreeSet<&str> {
        inv.nodes
            .iter()
            .filter(|n| r.spec.has_node(&n.name, &n.labels))
            .map(|n| n.name.as_str())
            .collect()
    };
    let mut allowed: BTreeMap<String, (BTreeSet<&str>, BTreeSet<String>)> = BTreeMap::new();
    for (rule, vms) in members.iter().filter(|(r, _)| !r.spec.kind.is_vm_rule()) {
        let roots: BTreeSet<String> = vms.iter().map(|vm| find(&mut parent, vm)).collect();
        for root in roots {
            let (nodes, why) = allowed
                .entry(root)
                .or_insert_with(|| (universe.clone(), BTreeSet::new()));
            let set = nodes_of(rule);
            if rule.spec.kind == RuleKind::NodeAffinity {
                nodes.retain(|n| set.contains(n));
            } else {
                nodes.retain(|n| !set.contains(n));
            }
            why.insert(rule.name.clone());
        }
    }
    for (root, (nodes, why)) in allowed {
        if nodes.is_empty() {
            bad.extend(why);
            bad.extend(joined.get(&root).into_iter().flatten().cloned());
        }
    }
    if bad.is_empty() {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(bad.into_iter().collect())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use opl_types::node::{Fencing, NodeHa, NodeSpec, NodeStatus};
    use opl_types::placement::{HaGroupNode, HaGroupSpec, PlacementRuleSpec};
    use opl_types::resource::Resource;
    use opl_types::vm::{
        Arch, CpuSpec, HaState, MachineType, MigrationStatus, VmHa, VmSpec, VmStatus,
    };

    use super::*;

    fn node(name: &str, memory_mib: u64, labels: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Node {
        let mut n = Resource::new(
            name,
            NodeSpec {
                address: "a".into(),
                maintenance: false,
                witness: false,
                roles: None,
            },
        );
        n.labels = labels
            .iter()
            .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), v.to_string()))
            .collect();
        n.status = NodeStatus {
            online: true,
            memory_mib,
            arch: Some(Arch::Aarch64),
            // HA VM(그룹 시험)도 받는다.
            ha: Some(NodeHa {
                fencing: Fencing::Process,
                recover_after_secs: 7,
            }),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        n
    }

    fn vm(name: &str, node: Option<&Node>, power: PowerState) -> Vm {
        Resource::new(
            name,
            VmSpec {
                cpu: CpuSpec {
                    sockets: 1,
                    cores: 1,
                    model: Default::default(),
                },
                memory_mib: 1024,
                firmware: Default::default(),
                machine: MachineType::Virt,
                disks: vec![],
                nics: vec![],
                power,
                restart: Default::default(),
                node: node.map(|n| n.id),
                snapshot_schedule: None,
                ha: None,
            },
        )
    }

    fn running(name: &str, node: &Node) -> Vm {
        vm(name, Some(node), PowerState::Running)
    }

    fn rule(name: &str, kind: RuleKind, vms: &[&str], nodes: &[&str]) -> PlacementRule {
        Resource::new(
            name,
            PlacementRuleSpec {
                kind,
                vms: vms.iter().map(|v| v.to_string()).collect(),
                vm_tag: None,
                nodes: nodes.iter().map(|n| n.to_string()).collect(),
                node_tag: None,
                weight: None,
                enabled: true,
                ha_may_violate: false,
            },
        )
    }

    fn group(name: &str, nodes: &[(&str, u32)], restricted: bool) -> HaGroup {
        Resource::new(
            name,
            HaGroupSpec {
                nodes: nodes
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(n, p)| HaGroupNode {
                        node: n.to_string(),
                        priority: *p,
                    })
                    .collect(),
                restricted,
                nofailback: false,
            },
        )
    }

    fn in_group(mut vm: Vm, group: &str) -> Vm {
        vm.spec.ha = Some(VmHa {
            group: Some(group.into()),
            ..Default::default()
        });
        vm
    }

    fn none() -> Assign {
        Assign::default()
    }

    #[test]
    fn hard_rules_of_each_kind() {
        let (n1, n2, n3) = (
            node("n1", 8192, &[]),
            node("n2", 8192, &[]),
            node("n3", 8192, &[]),
        );
        let me = vm("me", None, PowerState::Running);
        let mut inv = Inventory {
            nodes: vec![n1.clone(), n2.clone(), n3.clone()],
            vms: vec![running("web", &n1)],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let hard = |inv: &Inventory, n: &Node| hard_violations(&me, n, inv, &none());

        inv.rules = vec![rule("together", RuleKind::Affinity, &["me", "web"], &[])];
        assert!(hard(&inv, &n1).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(hard(&inv, &n2), ["together"]);

        inv.rules = vec![rule("apart", RuleKind::AntiAffinity, &["me", "web"], &[])];
        assert_eq!(hard(&inv, &n1), ["apart"]);
        assert!(hard(&inv, &n2).is_empty());

        inv.rules = vec![rule("only", RuleKind::NodeAffinity, &["me"], &["n2", "n3"])];
        assert_eq!(hard(&inv, &n1), ["only"]);
        assert!(hard(&inv, &n3).is_empty());

        inv.rules = vec![rule("never", RuleKind::NodeAntiAffinity, &["me"], &["n2"])];
        assert!(hard(&inv, &n1).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(hard(&inv, &n2), ["never"]);
        assert_eq!(
            candidates(&me, &inv, &none())
                .iter()
                .map(|c| c.node)
                .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>(),
            BTreeSet::from([n1.id, n3.id])
        );

        // 규칙에 들지 않은 VM은 상관없다. soft 규칙은 hard 위반이 아니다.
        let other = vm("other", None, PowerState::Running);
        assert!(hard_violations(&other, &n2, &inv, &none()).is_empty());
        inv.rules = vec![rule(
            "pref",
            RuleKind::SoftNodeAntiAffinity,
            &["me"],
            &["n2"],
        )];
        assert!(hard(&inv, &n2).is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn soft_penalties_use_weight_and_member_counts() {
        let (n1, n2) = (node("n1", 8192, &[]), node("n2", 8192, &[]));
        let me = vm("me", None, PowerState::Running);
        let mut inv = Inventory {
            nodes: vec![n1.clone(), n2.clone()],
            vms: vec![running("a", &n1), running("b", &n1), running("c", &n2)],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let pen = |inv: &Inventory, n: &Node| soft(&me, n, inv, &none()).0;

        let mut near = rule("near", RuleKind::SoftAffinity, &["me", "a", "b", "c"], &[]);
        near.spec.weight = Some(10);
        inv.rules = vec![near];
        // N 밖의 구성원 수 × weight
        assert_eq!(pen(&inv, &n1), 10);
        assert_eq!(pen(&inv, &n2), 20);
        assert_eq!(soft_violations(&me, &n1, &inv, &none()), ["near"]);

        // N의 구성원 수 × weight(없으면 50)
        inv.rules = vec![rule(
            "spread",
            RuleKind::SoftAntiAffinity,
            &["me", "a", "b", "c"],
            &[],
        )];
        assert_eq!(pen(&inv, &n1), 100);
        assert_eq!(pen(&inv, &n2), 50);

        let mut pref = rule("pref", RuleKind::SoftNodeAffinity, &["me"], &["n2"]);
        pref.spec.weight = Some(7);
        let mut avoid = rule("avoid", RuleKind::SoftNodeAntiAffinity, &["me"], &["n2"]);
        avoid.spec.weight = Some(3);
        inv.rules = vec![pref, avoid];
        assert_eq!(pen(&inv, &n1), 7);
        assert_eq!(pen(&inv, &n2), 3);
        assert_eq!(soft_violations(&me, &n2, &inv, &none()), ["avoid"]);
        // soft 규칙은 후보를 빼지 않고 벌점으로 순서를 정한다.
        let found = candidates(&me, &inv, &none());
        assert_eq!(found.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(found[0].node, n2.id);
        assert_eq!(found[0].penalty, 3);
    }

    #[test]
    fn tags_pick_vms_by_label_and_nodes_by_zone() {
        let a = node("n1", 8192, &[("zone", "rack-a")]);
        let b = node("n2", 8192, &[("zone", "rack-b")]);
        let mut me = vm("me", None, PowerState::Running);
        me.labels.insert("app".into(), "db".into());
        let mut peer = running("peer", &a);
        peer.labels.insert("app".into(), "db".into());
        let mut zone = rule("in-a", RuleKind::NodeAffinity, &[], &[]);
        zone.spec.vm_tag = Some("app=db".into());
        zone.spec.node_tag = Some("zone=rack-b".into());
        let mut apart = rule("apart", RuleKind::AntiAffinity, &[], &[]);
        apart.spec.vm_tag = Some("app=db".into());
        let inv = Inventory {
            nodes: vec![a.clone(), b.clone()],
            vms: vec![peer, running("plain", &b)],
            rules: vec![zone, apart],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert_eq!(hard_violations(&me, &a, &inv, &none()), ["apart", "in-a"]);
        assert!(hard_violations(&me, &b, &inv, &none()).is_empty());
        // 레이블이 없는 VM은 태그 규칙에 들지 않는다.
        let plain = vm("plain2", None, PowerState::Running);
        assert!(hard_violations(&plain, &a, &inv, &none()).is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn stopped_vms_do_not_count_and_migrating_vms_hold_both_nodes() {
        let (n1, n2, n3) = (
            node("n1", 8192, &[]),
            node("n2", 8192, &[]),
            node("n3", 8192, &[]),
        );
        let me = vm("me", None, PowerState::Running);
        let mut inv = Inventory {
            nodes: vec![n1.clone(), n2.clone(), n3.clone()],
            vms: vec![vm("web", Some(&n1), PowerState::Stopped)],
            rules: vec![rule("apart", RuleKind::AntiAffinity, &["me", "web"], &[])],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        // 꺼진 VM은 마지막 노드에 붙어 있어도 자리를 차지하지 않는다.
        assert!(hard_violations(&me, &n1, &inv, &none()).is_empty());

        let mut web = running("web", &n1);
        web.status = VmStatus {
            migration: Some(MigrationStatus {
                node: n2.id,
                task: Uuid::now_v7(),
                disks: vec![],
            }),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        inv.vms = vec![web];
        assert_eq!(hard_violations(&me, &n1, &inv, &none()), ["apart"]);
        assert_eq!(hard_violations(&me, &n2, &inv, &none()), ["apart"]);
        assert!(hard_violations(&me, &n3, &inv, &none()).is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn assign_overrides_where_vms_are() {
        let (n1, n2) = (node("n1", 8192, &[]), node("n2", 8192, &[]));
        let me = vm("me", None, PowerState::Running);
        let web = running("web", &n1);
        let off = vm("off", None, PowerState::Stopped);
        let inv = Inventory {
            nodes: vec![n1.clone(), n2.clone()],
            vms: vec![web.clone(), off.clone()],
            rules: vec![rule(
                "apart",
                RuleKind::AntiAffinity,
                &["me", "web", "off"],
                &[],
            )],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert_eq!(hard_violations(&me, &n1, &inv, &none()), ["apart"]);
        assert!(hard_violations(&me, &n2, &inv, &none()).is_empty());

        // 복구가 web을 n2로 옮겼다고 본다: 이제 n1이 비고 n2를 차지한다. 메모리도 따라간다.
        let mut moved = Assign::default();
        moved.place(web.id, n2.id);
        assert!(hard_violations(&me, &n1, &inv, &moved).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(hard_violations(&me, &n2, &inv, &moved), ["apart"]);
        assert_eq!(free_mib(&me, &n1, &inv, &moved), 8192);
        assert_eq!(free_mib(&me, &n2, &inv, &moved), 8192 - 1024);
        // 꺼진 VM도 자리를 주면 차지하고, 자리를 빼면 아무 데도 없다.
        moved.place(off.id, n1.id);
        assert_eq!(hard_violations(&me, &n1, &inv, &moved), ["apart"]);
        moved.unplace(web.id);
        moved.unplace(off.id);
        assert!(hard_violations(&me, &n1, &inv, &moved).is_empty());
        assert!(hard_violations(&me, &n2, &inv, &moved).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(free_mib(&me, &n1, &inv, &moved), 8192);
    }

    #[test]
    fn disabled_rules_are_ignored() {
        let (n1, n2) = (node("n1", 8192, &[]), node("n2", 8192, &[]));
        let me = vm("me", None, PowerState::Running);
        let mut never = rule("never", RuleKind::NodeAntiAffinity, &["me"], &["n1"]);
        let mut avoid = rule("avoid", RuleKind::SoftNodeAntiAffinity, &["me"], &["n1"]);
        never.spec.enabled = false;
        avoid.spec.enabled = false;
        let inv = Inventory {
            nodes: vec![n1.clone(), n2],
            rules: vec![never, avoid],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert!(hard_violations(&me, &n1, &inv, &none()).is_empty());
        assert!(soft_violations(&me, &n1, &inv, &none()).is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn order_is_priority_then_penalty_then_memory_then_id() {
        let c = |priority, penalty, free_mib, node: u128| Candidate {
            node: Uuid::from_u128(node),
            priority,
            penalty,
            free_mib,
        };
        let mut list = vec![
            c(None, 0, 9000, 1),
            c(Some(0), 50, 100, 2),
            c(Some(2), 50, 100, 3),
            c(Some(2), 10, 100, 4),
            c(Some(2), 10, 900, 5),
            c(Some(2), 10, 900, 6),
        ];
        assert_eq!(best(&list), Some(c(Some(2), 10, 900, 5)));
        list.sort_by(compare);
        let order: Vec<u128> = list.iter().map(|c| c.node.as_u128()).collect();
        assert_eq!(order, [5, 6, 4, 3, 2, 1]);
        assert_eq!(best(&[]), None);

        // 우선순위가 같으면 벌점, 벌점도 같으면 메모리가 많은 노드
        let (n1, n2, n3) = (
            node("n1", 4096, &[]),
            node("n2", 8192, &[]),
            node("n3", 2048, &[]),
        );
        let me = vm("me", None, PowerState::Running);
        let mut avoid = rule("avoid", RuleKind::SoftNodeAntiAffinity, &["me"], &["n2"]);
        avoid.spec.weight = Some(1);
        let mut inv = Inventory {
            nodes: vec![n1.clone(), n2.clone(), n3.clone()],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert_eq!(best(&candidates(&me, &inv, &none())).unwrap().node, n2.id);
        inv.rules = vec![avoid];
        assert_eq!(best(&candidates(&me, &inv, &none())).unwrap().node, n1.id);
        // 그룹 우선순위가 벌점보다 앞선다.
        inv.groups = vec![group("g", &[("n2", 5), ("n3", 1)], false)];
        let me = in_group(me, "g");
        let found = candidates(&me, &inv, &none());
        let order: Vec<_> = found.iter().map(|c| (c.node, c.priority)).collect();
        assert_eq!(order, [(n2.id, Some(5)), (n3.id, Some(1)), (n1.id, None)]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn restricted_groups_keep_vms_on_their_nodes() {
        let (n1, n2, n3) = (
            node("n1", 8192, &[]),
            node("n2", 8192, &[]),
            node("n3", 8192, &[]),
        );
        let mut offline = n2.clone();
        offline.status.online = false;
        let open = group("open", &[("n2", 1)], false);
        let closed = group("closed", &[("n2", 1)], true);
        let mut inv = Inventory {
            nodes: vec![n1.clone(), offline, n3.clone()],
            groups: vec![open, closed],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        // 그룹 노드가 꺼져 있으면, restricted가 아닌 그룹은 다른 노드로 가고 restricted 그룹은 갈 곳이 없다.
        let free = in_group(vm("free", None, PowerState::Running), "open");
        assert_eq!(candidates(&free, &inv, &none()).len(), 2);
        let kept = in_group(vm("kept", None, PowerState::Running), "closed");
        assert!(candidates(&kept, &inv, &none()).is_empty());
        assert_eq!(
            hard_violations(&kept, &n1, &inv, &none()),
            ["ha-group:closed"]
        );
        inv.nodes[1] = n2.clone();
        assert_eq!(
            candidates(&kept, &inv, &none())
                .iter()
                .map(|c| c.node)
                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            [n2.id]
        );
        // HA를 잠시 끈(ignored) VM에는 그룹을 쓰지 않는다.
        let mut ignored = kept.clone();
        ignored.spec.ha.as_mut().unwrap().state = HaState::Ignored;
        assert!(hard_violations(&ignored, &n1, &inv, &none()).is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn conflicts_find_affinity_against_anti_affinity_transitively() {
        let inv = Inventory {
            nodes: vec![node("n1", 1, &[]), node("n2", 1, &[])],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let ab = rule("ab", RuleKind::Affinity, &["a", "b"], &[]);
        let bc = rule("bc", RuleKind::Affinity, &["b", "c"], &[]);
        let ac = rule("ac-apart", RuleKind::AntiAffinity, &["a", "c"], &[]);
        let ad = rule("ad-apart", RuleKind::AntiAffinity, &["a", "d"], &[]);
        assert_eq!(
            conflicts(&[ab.clone(), ac.clone(), ad.clone()], &inv),
            Ok(())
        );
        assert_eq!(
            conflicts(&[ab.clone(), bc.clone(), ac.clone(), ad.clone()], &inv),
            Err(vec!["ab".into(), "ac-apart".into(), "bc".into()])
        );
        // 꺼진 규칙과 soft 규칙은 모순으로 보지 않는다.
        let mut off = bc.clone();
        off.spec.enabled = false;
        assert_eq!(conflicts(&[ab.clone(), off, ac.clone()], &inv), Ok(()));
        let soft = rule("soft", RuleKind::SoftAntiAffinity, &["a", "b"], &[]);
        assert_eq!(conflicts(&[ab.clone(), soft], &inv), Ok(()));
        // 태그는 지금의 VM 레이블로 푼다.
        let mut tagged = rule("tagged", RuleKind::AntiAffinity, &[], &[]);
        tagged.spec.vm_tag = Some("tier=db".into());
        let mut a = vm("a", None, PowerState::Stopped);
        let mut b = vm("b", None, PowerState::Stopped);
        a.labels.insert("tier".into(), "db".into());
        b.labels.insert("tier".into(), "db".into());
        let inv = Inventory {
            vms: vec![a, b],
            ..inv
        };
        assert_eq!(
            conflicts(&[ab, tagged], &inv),
            Err(vec!["ab".into(), "tagged".into()])
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn conflicts_find_affinity_groups_with_no_allowed_node() {
        let mut witness = node("w", 1, &[]);
        witness.spec.witness = true;
        let inv = Inventory {
            nodes: vec![
                node("n1", 1, &[("zone", "a")]),
                node("n2", 1, &[("zone", "b")]),
                witness,
            ],
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let ab = rule("ab", RuleKind::Affinity, &["a", "b"], &[]);
        let a_n1 = rule("a-n1", RuleKind::NodeAffinity, &["a"], &["n1"]);
        let b_n2 = rule("b-n2", RuleKind::NodeAffinity, &["b"], &["n2"]);
        assert_eq!(conflicts(&[a_n1.clone(), b_n2.clone()], &inv), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(
            conflicts(&[ab.clone(), a_n1.clone(), b_n2.clone()], &inv),
            Err(vec!["a-n1".into(), "ab".into(), "b-n2".into()])
        );
        // 혼자인 VM도: 허용 노드에서 금지 노드를 빼면 빈다(위트니스는 세지 않는다).
        let mut not_a = rule("not-zone-a", RuleKind::NodeAntiAffinity, &["c"], &[]);
        not_a.spec.node_tag = Some("zone=a".into());
        let c_n1 = rule("c-n1", RuleKind::NodeAffinity, &["c"], &["n1"]);
        assert_eq!(
            conflicts(&[not_a.clone(), c_n1], &inv),
            Err(vec!["c-n1".into(), "not-zone-a".into()])
        );
        let not_b = rule("not-n2", RuleKind::NodeAntiAffinity, &["c"], &["n2"]);
        assert_eq!(
            conflicts(&[not_a, not_b], &inv),
            Err(vec!["not-n2".into(), "not-zone-a".into()])
        );
        assert_eq!(conflicts(&[ab, a_n1], &inv), Ok(()));
    }
}
```

`crates/opl-api/src/placement_rules.rs`를 만든다:

```rust
//! 배치 규칙 만들기·바꾸기·지우기. 목록과 조회는 `resources`의 공통 핸들러다.

use std::sync::Arc;

use axum::extract::{Path, State};
use axum::http::{HeaderMap, StatusCode};
use opl_types::node::HA_PLACEMENT;
use opl_types::placement::{PlacementRule, PlacementRuleSpec, PlacementRuleStatus};
use opl_types::resource::{Resource, ResourceSpec};

use crate::auth::{Action, Principal};
use crate::cluster::require_feature;
use crate::error::{ApiError, Json};
use crate::placement::conflicts;
use crate::resources::{CreateRequest, UpdateRequest, check_name, if_match, lookup};
use crate::scheduler::Inventory;
use crate::state::AppState;

/// 형식(400), 규칙의 노드가 모두 있는지(400), 모든 노드가 새 종류를 아는지(409 `cluster_upgrading`),
/// 이 규칙이 다른 켜진 hard 규칙과 모순인지(422 `rule_conflict`, `details.rules`)
fn check(state: &AppState, rule: &PlacementRule) -> Result<(), ApiError> {
    rule.spec
        .validate()
        .map_err(|e| ApiError::bad_request(e.to_string()))?;
    let mut inv = Inventory::load(&state.cluster)?;
    for node in &rule.spec.nodes {
        if !inv.nodes.iter().any(|n| &n.name == node) {
            return Err(ApiError::bad_request(format!("node {node:?} not found")));
        }
    }
    // 옛 노드는 이 종류의 로그 항목을 풀지 못한다.
    require_feature(&state.cluster, HA_PLACEMENT)?;
    inv.rules.retain(|r| r.name != rule.name);
    inv.rules.push(rule.clone());
    // 이 규칙이 든 모순만 거절한다(그 뒤 레이블이 바뀌어 생긴 다른 규칙끼리의 모순은 위반으로 보인다).
    if let Err(names) = conflicts(&inv.rules, &inv)
        && names.contains(&rule.name)
    {
        let mut e = ApiError::new(
            StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            "rule_conflict",
            format!(
                "placement rule {:?} contradicts other rules: {}",
                rule.name,
                names.join(", ")
            ),
        );
        e.details = Some(serde_json::json!({ "rules": names }));
        return Err(e);
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// VM끼리(`affinity`·`anti-affinity`와 `soft-` 형태) 또는 VM과 노드(`node-affinity`·`node-anti-affinity`와
/// `soft-` 형태) 배치 규칙. VM은 이름(`vms`)이나 레이블(`vm_tag`), 노드는 이름(`nodes`)이나 노드 레이블
/// (`node_tag`, 예: `zone=rack-a`)로 고른다. 켜진 hard 규칙끼리 모순이면 422 `rule_conflict`. 이미 놓인 VM은
/// 옮기지 않는다. 모든 노드가 `ha-placement`를 알아야 한다.
#[utoipa::path(post, path = "/placement-rules", tag = "ha",
    request_body = CreateRequest<PlacementRuleSpec>,
    responses((status = 201, body = Resource<PlacementRuleSpec, PlacementRuleStatus>), (status = "4XX", body = crate::error::ErrorBody)))]
pub async fn create_placement_rule(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
    principal: Principal,
    Json(req): Json<CreateRequest<PlacementRuleSpec>>,
) -> Result<(StatusCode, Json<PlacementRule>), ApiError> {
    state.authorize(&principal, Action::Write, PlacementRuleSpec::KIND)?;
    check_name(&req.name)?;
    let mut rule = Resource::new(req.name, req.spec);
    rule.labels = req.labels;
    // VM 만들기·바꾸기와 같은 잠금: 함께 들어온 규칙끼리 모순 검사를 지나 함께 저장되지 않게.
    let _lock = state.vm_lock.lock().await;
    check(&state, &rule)?;
    rule.revision = state.cluster.create(&rule).await?;
    Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(rule)))
}

/// 규칙을 통째로 바꾼다(`enabled`로 켜고 끈다).
#[utoipa::path(put, path = "/placement-rules/{key}", tag = "ha",
    params(("key" = String, Path, description = "id or name"), ("If-Match" = Option<u64>, Header)),
    request_body = UpdateRequest<PlacementRuleSpec>,
    responses((status = 200, body = Resource<PlacementRuleSpec, PlacementRuleStatus>), (status = "4XX", body = crate::error::ErrorBody)))]
pub async fn update_placement_rule(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
    principal: Principal,
    Path(key): Path<String>,
    headers: HeaderMap,
    Json(req): Json<UpdateRequest<PlacementRuleSpec>>,
) -> Result<Json<PlacementRule>, ApiError> {
    state.authorize(&principal, Action::Write, PlacementRuleSpec::KIND)?;
    let _lock = state.vm_lock.lock().await;
    let mut rule = lookup::<PlacementRuleSpec>(&state.cluster, &key)?;
    rule.spec = req.spec;
    rule.labels = req.labels;
    check(&state, &rule)?;
    state
        .cluster
        .update_spec(
            rule.id,
            if_match(&headers)?,
            rule.labels.clone(),
            &rule.spec,
        )
        .await?;
    Ok(Json(lookup::<PlacementRuleSpec>(
        &state.cluster,
        &rule.id.to_string(),
    )?))
}

#[utoipa::path(delete, path = "/placement-rules/{key}", tag = "ha",
    params(("key" = String, Path, description = "id or name"), ("If-Match" = Option<u64>, Header)),
    responses((status = 204, description = "Deleted"), (status = "4XX", body = crate::error::ErrorBody)))]
pub async fn delete_placement_rule(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>,
    principal: Principal,
    Path(key): Path<String>,
    headers: HeaderMap,
) -> Result<StatusCode, ApiError> {
    state.authorize(&principal, Action::Write, PlacementRuleSpec::KIND)?;
    let rule = lookup::<PlacementRuleSpec>(&state.cluster, &key)?;
    state
        .cluster
        .delete::<PlacementRuleSpec>(rule.id, if_match(&headers)?)
        .await?;
    Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
}
```

```rust
    assert_eq!(ha, Some(VmHa::default()));
```

`crates/opl-api/tests/ha_groups.rs`를 만든다:

```rust
//! HA 그룹 API: 관리자만 만들고 바꾸고 지우며, VM이 `ha.group`으로 쓰고, 쓰는 동안 지울 수 없다.

mod common;

use common::{Env, vm_request};
use opl_types::node::{HA_PLACEMENT, NodeSpec};
use reqwest::StatusCode;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

fn group(name: &str, spec: Value) -> Value {
    json!({ "name": name, "spec": spec })
}

/// 이 노드의 `ha-placement` 기능 표시를 지우거나 되살린다(옛 노드 흉내).
async fn set_ha_placement(env: &Env, on: bool) {
    let mut status = env
        .cluster
        .get::<NodeSpec>(env.node)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
        .status;
    status.features.retain(|f| f != HA_PLACEMENT);
    if on {
        status.features.push(HA_PLACEMENT.into());
    }
    env.cluster
        .update_status::<NodeSpec>(env.node, &status)
        .await
        .unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn admins_manage_ha_groups_and_others_read() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let operator = env.user("operator", "operator").await;
    let viewer = env.user("viewer", "viewer").await;

    let (status, body) = admin
        .post(
            "/ha-groups",
            group("rack-a", json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "node1" }] })),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CREATED, "{body}");
    // 빠진 값은 기본값이다.
    assert_eq!(
        body["spec"],
        json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "node1", "priority": 0 }], "restricted": false, "nofailback": false })
    );

    // 운영자는 읽기만 한다.
    let spec = json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "node1", "priority": 5 }], "restricted": true });
    assert_eq!(
        operator
            .post("/ha-groups", group("other", spec.clone()))
            .await
            .0,
        StatusCode::FORBIDDEN
    );
    assert_eq!(
        operator
            .put("/ha-groups/rack-a", json!({ "spec": spec.clone() }), None)
            .await
            .0,
        StatusCode::FORBIDDEN
    );
    assert_eq!(
        operator.delete("/ha-groups/rack-a").await.0,
        StatusCode::FORBIDDEN
    );
    let (status, list) = viewer.get("/ha-groups").await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{list}");
    assert_eq!(list["items"][0]["name"], "rack-a");

    // 통째로 바꾼다.
    let (status, body) = admin
        .put("/ha-groups/rack-a", json!({ "spec": spec }), None)
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(body["spec"]["nodes"][0]["priority"], 5);
    assert_eq!(body["spec"]["restricted"], true);
    let (status, body) = viewer.get("/ha-groups/rack-a").await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(body["spec"]["restricted"], true);

    assert_eq!(
        admin.delete("/ha-groups/rack-a").await.0,
        StatusCode::NO_CONTENT
    );
    assert_eq!(
        viewer.get("/ha-groups/rack-a").await.0,
        StatusCode::NOT_FOUND
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn invalid_groups_are_rejected() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    for (spec, message) in [
        (json!({ "nodes": [] }), "nodes must not be empty"),
        (
            json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "node1" }, { "node": "node1" }] }),
            "node \"node1\" is listed more than once",
        ),
        (
            json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "node1", "priority": 1001 }] }),
            "the priority of node \"node1\" must be between 0 and 1000",
        ),
        (
            json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "ghost" }] }),
            "node \"ghost\" not found",
        ),
    ] {
        let (status, body) = admin.post("/ha-groups", group("g", spec.clone())).await;
        assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "{spec}: {body}");
        assert_eq!(body["message"], message, "{spec}");
    }
    let (status, body) = admin
        .post(
            "/ha-groups",
            group(
                "g",
                json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "node1" }], "failback": true }),
            ),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "{body}");
}

/// VM은 있는 그룹만 쓰고, VM이 쓰는 그룹은 지울 수 없다.
#[tokio::test]
async fn groups_in_use_cannot_be_deleted() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let mut req = vm_request("web");
    req["spec"]["ha"] = json!({ "group": "rack-a" });
    let (status, body) = admin.post("/vms", req.clone()).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(body["message"], "HA group \"rack-a\" not found");

    let (status, body) = admin
        .post(
            "/ha-groups",
            group("rack-a", json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "node1" }] })),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CREATED, "{body}");
    let (status, vm) = admin.post("/vms", req).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CREATED, "{vm}");
    assert_eq!(vm["spec"]["ha"]["group"], "rack-a");

    let (status, body) = admin.delete("/ha-groups/rack-a").await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CONFLICT, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(body["code"], "group_in_use");
    assert_eq!(body["message"], "HA group \"rack-a\" is used by VM \"web\"");

    let mut spec = vm["spec"].clone();
    spec["ha"] = json!(false);
    let (status, body) = admin.put("/vms/web", json!({ "spec": spec }), None).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(
        admin.delete("/ha-groups/rack-a").await.0,
        StatusCode::NO_CONTENT
    );
}

/// 옛 노드가 있으면 새 종류를 쓰지 않는다.
#[tokio::test]
async fn groups_wait_for_all_nodes() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let spec = json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "node1" }] });
    let (status, _) = admin.post("/ha-groups", group("g", spec.clone())).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CREATED);

    set_ha_placement(&env, false).await;
    let (status, body) = admin.post("/ha-groups", group("h", spec.clone())).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CONFLICT, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(body["code"], "cluster_upgrading");
    let (status, body) = admin
        .put("/ha-groups/g", json!({ "spec": spec }), None)
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CONFLICT, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(body["code"], "cluster_upgrading");
    // 지우기는 된다.
    assert_eq!(admin.delete("/ha-groups/g").await.0, StatusCode::NO_CONTENT);
}
```

```rust
//! 배치 규칙 API: 관리자만 만들고 바꾸고 지우며, 켜진 hard 규칙끼리의 모순은 422로 거절한다.

mod common;

use std::time::Duration;

use common::{Client, Env};
use futures_util::StreamExt;
use opl_types::node::{HA_PLACEMENT, NodeSpec};
use reqwest::StatusCode;
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use tokio_tungstenite::tungstenite::Message;
use tokio_tungstenite::tungstenite::client::IntoClientRequest;

fn rule(name: &str, spec: Value) -> Value {
    json!({ "name": name, "spec": spec })
}

/// 이 노드의 `ha-placement` 기능 표시를 지운다(옛 노드 흉내).
async fn drop_ha_placement(env: &Env) {
    let mut status = env
        .cluster
        .get::<NodeSpec>(env.node)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
        .status;
    status.features.retain(|f| f != HA_PLACEMENT);
    env.cluster
        .update_status::<NodeSpec>(env.node, &status)
        .await
        .unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn admins_manage_rules_and_others_read() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let operator = env.user("operator", "operator").await;
    let viewer = env.user("viewer", "viewer").await;

    let (status, body) = admin
        .post(
            "/placement-rules",
            rule(
                "apart",
                json!({ "kind": "anti-affinity", "vms": ["web-1", "web-2"] }),
            ),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::CREATED, "{body}");
    // 아직 없는 VM이어도 된다. 빠진 값은 기본값이다.
    assert_eq!(body["spec"]["enabled"], true);
    assert_eq!(body["spec"]["ha_may_violate"], false);
    assert_eq!(body["spec"]["nodes"], json!([]));

    let spec =
        json!({ "kind": "soft-node-affinity", "vms": ["db"], "node_tag": "zone=a", "weight": 20 });
    assert_eq!(
        operator
            .post("/placement-rules", rule("db-zone", spec.clone()))
            .await
            .0,
        StatusCode::FORBIDDEN
    );
    assert_eq!(
        operator
            .put(
                "/placement-rules/apart",
                json!({ "spec": spec.clone() }),
                None
            )
            .await
            .0,
        StatusCode::FORBIDDEN
    );
    assert_eq!(
        operator.delete("/placement-rules/apart").await.0,
        StatusCode::FORBIDDEN
    );
    let (status, list) = viewer.get("/placement-rules").await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{list}");
    assert_eq!(list["items"][0]["name"], "apart");

    // 통째로 바꾸고, `enabled`로 끈다.
    let (status, body) = admin
        .put("/placement-rules/apart", json!({ "spec": spec }), None)
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(body["spec"]["kind"], "soft-node-affinity");
    assert_eq!(body["spec"]["weight"], 20);
    let mut off = body["spec"].clone();
    off["enabled"] = json!(false);
    let (status, body) = admin
        .put(
            "/placement-rules/apart",
            json!({ "spec": off }),
            body["revision"].as_u64(),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::OK, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(
        viewer.get("/placement-rules/apart").await.1["spec"]["enabled"],
        false
    );

    assert_eq!(
        admin.delete("/placement-rules/apart").await.0,
        StatusCode::NO_CONTENT
    );
    assert_eq!(
        viewer.get("/placement-rules/apart").await.0,
        StatusCode::NOT_FOUND
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn invalid_rules_are_rejected() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    for (spec, message) in [
        (
            json!({ "kind": "affinity", "vms": ["a", "b"], "vm_tag": "app=web" }),
            "give exactly one of vms and vm_tag",
        ),
        (
            json!({ "kind": "anti-affinity", "vms": ["a"] }),
            "anti-affinity rules need at least two VMs",
        ),
        (
            json!({ "kind": "affinity", "vms": ["a", "b"], "nodes": ["node1"] }),
            "affinity rules are between VMs; they take no nodes or node_tag",
        ),
        (
            json!({ "kind": "node-affinity", "vms": ["a"] }),
            "node-affinity rules need exactly one of nodes and node_tag",
        ),
        (
            json!({ "kind": "anti-affinity", "vms": ["a", "b"], "weight": 10 }),
            "weight is only for soft rules, not anti-affinity",
        ),
        (
            json!({ "kind": "soft-affinity", "vms": ["a", "b"], "ha_may_violate": true }),
            "ha_may_violate is only for hard rules, not soft-affinity",
        ),
        (
            json!({ "kind": "soft-anti-affinity", "vm_tag": "app", }),
            "tag \"app\" must be key=value",
        ),
        (
            json!({ "kind": "node-anti-affinity", "vms": ["a"], "nodes": ["ghost"] }),
            "node \"ghost\" not found",
        ),
    ] {
        let (status, body) = admin
            .post("/placement-rules", rule("r", spec.clone()))
            .await;
        assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "{spec}: {body}");
        assert_eq!(body["message"], message, "{spec}");
    }
    let (status, body) = admin
        .post(
            "/placement-rules",
            rule(
                "r",
                json!({ "kind": "affinity", "vms": ["a", "b"], "priority": 1 }),
            ),
        )
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "{body}");
}

/// 켜진 hard 규칙끼리 모순이면 422 `rule_conflict`로 거절하고 관련 규칙을 `details.rules`로 알린다.
#[tokio::test]
async fn contradicting_rules_are_rejected() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let post = |name: &str, spec: Value| admin.post("/placement-rules", rule(name, spec));
    assert_eq!(
        post("ab", json!({ "kind": "affinity", "vms": ["a", "b"] }))
            .await
            .0,
        StatusCode::CREATED
    );
    assert_eq!(
        post("bc", json!({ "kind": "affinity", "vms": ["b", "c"] }))
            .await
            .0,
        StatusCode::CREATED
    );
    // a와 c는 b를 거쳐 함께 있어야 한다.
    let apart = json!({ "kind": "anti-affinity", "vms": ["a", "c"] });
    let (status, body) = post("apart", apart.clone()).await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(body["code"], "rule_conflict");
    assert_eq!(body["details"]["rules"], json!(["ab", "apart", "bc"]));
    assert_eq!(
        body["message"],
        "placement rule \"apart\" contradicts other rules: ab, apart, bc"
    );
    // soft 규칙과 꺼진 규칙은 모순이 아니다. 켜면 422다.
    let mut off = apart.clone();
    off["enabled"] = json!(false);
    assert_eq!(post("apart", off).await.0, StatusCode::CREATED);
    let (status, body) = admin
        .put("/placement-rules/apart", json!({ "spec": apart }), None)
        .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(
        post(
            "spread",
            json!({ "kind": "soft-anti-affinity", "vms": ["a", "c"] })
        )
        .await
        .0,
        StatusCode::CREATED
    );

    // 묶음의 허용 노드가 비면 모순이다.
    assert_eq!(
        post(
            "a-here",
            json!({ "kind": "node-affinity", "vms": ["a"], "nodes": ["node1"] })
        )
        .await
        .0,
        StatusCode::CREATED
    );
    let (status, body) = post(
        "c-not-here",
        json!({ "kind": "node-anti-affinity", "vms": ["c"], "nodes": ["node1"] }),
    )
    .await;
    assert_eq!(status, StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, "{body}");
    assert_eq!(
        body["details"]["rules"],
        json!(["a-here", "ab", "bc", "c-not-here"])
    );
}

/// 함께 들어온 모순인 규칙 둘은 하나만 저장된다(검사와 쓰기가 잠금 안에서).
#[tokio::test]
async fn contradicting_rules_created_together_are_not_both_stored() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    for round in 0..5 {
        let (a, b) = (format!("a{round}"), format!("b{round}"));
        let vms = json!([a, b]);
        let (together, apart) = tokio::join!(
            admin.post(
                "/placement-rules",
                rule(
                    &format!("together-{round}"),
                    json!({ "kind": "affinity", "vms": vms })
                )
            ),
            admin.post(
                "/placement-rules",
                rule(
                    &format!("apart-{round}"),
                    json!({ "kind": "anti-affinity", "vms": vms })
                )
            ),
        );
        let mut got = [together.0, apart.0];
        got.sort();
        assert_eq!(
            got,
            [StatusCode::CREATED, StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY],
            "{} {}",
            together.1,
            apart.1
        );
    }
}

        StatusCode::NO_CONTENT
    );
}

type Socket =
    tokio_tungstenite::WebSocketStream<tokio_tungstenite::MaybeTlsStream<tokio::net::TcpStream>>;

async fn connect(client: &Client, path: &str) -> Socket {
    let url = format!("{}/api/v1{path}", client.base.replace("http://", "ws://"));
    let mut req = url.into_client_request().unwrap();
    let token = client.token.as_ref().unwrap();
    req.headers_mut()
        .insert("authorization", format!("Bearer {token}").parse().unwrap());
    tokio_tungstenite::connect_async(req).await.unwrap().0
}

async fn next_json(ws: &mut Socket) -> Value {
    loop {
        let msg = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), ws.next())
            .await
            .expect("no message")
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
        if let Message::Text(text) = msg {
            return serde_json::from_str(&text).unwrap();
        }
    }
}

/// 규칙과 그룹의 변경을 구독할 수 있다.
#[tokio::test]
async fn rules_and_groups_are_watched() {
    let env = Env::start().await;
    let admin = env.admin().await;
    let viewer = env.user("viewer", "viewer").await;
    let since = viewer.get("/placement-rules").await.1["revision"]
        .as_u64()
        .unwrap();
    let mut ws = connect(
        &viewer,
        &format!("/watch?kinds=placement-rule,ha-group&since={since}"),
    )
    .await;
    admin
        .post(
            "/placement-rules",
            rule("ab", json!({ "kind": "affinity", "vms": ["a", "b"] })),
        )
        .await;
    let ev = next_json(&mut ws).await;
    assert_eq!(ev["kind"], "placement-rule");
    assert_eq!(ev["resource"]["name"], "ab");
    admin
        .post(
            "/ha-groups",
            json!({ "name": "g", "spec": { "nodes": [{ "node": "node1" }] } }),
        )
        .await;
    let ev = next_json(&mut ws).await;
    assert_eq!(ev["kind"], "ha-group");
    assert_eq!(ev["resource"]["name"], "g");
}
```

```rust
//! HA 그룹과 배치 규칙(설계 §8). 규칙의 계산(조건·벌점)은 opl-api `placement`가 한다.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use thiserror::Error;

use crate::resource::{Kind, Resource, ResourceSpec, validate_name};

pub type HaGroup = Resource<HaGroupSpec, HaGroupStatus>;
pub type PlacementRule = Resource<PlacementRuleSpec, PlacementRuleStatus>;

/// HA 그룹 노드 우선순위의 최댓값
pub const MAX_PRIORITY: u32 = 1000;
/// soft 규칙의 weight 범위와 기본값
pub const MAX_WEIGHT: u8 = 100;
pub const DEFAULT_WEIGHT: u8 = 50;

/// HA 그룹: HA VM을 복구할 노드와 그 우선순위. VM은 `ha.group`으로 그룹을 쓴다.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", derive(utoipa::ToSchema))]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct HaGroupSpec {
    /// 그룹 노드. 우선순위가 큰 노드에 먼저 놓는다.
    pub nodes: Vec<HaGroupNode>,
    /// 켜면 그룹 밖 노드에는 놓지 않는다(놓을 곳이 없으면 켜지 않는다).
    #[serde(default)]
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", schema(default))]
    pub restricted: bool,
    /// 켜면 우선순위가 더 높은 노드가 돌아와도 되돌아가지 않는다.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", schema(default))]
    pub nofailback: bool,
}

/// HA 그룹의 노드 하나
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", derive(utoipa::ToSchema))]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct HaGroupNode {
    /// 노드 이름
    pub node: String,
    /// 0~1000, 클수록 먼저
    #[serde(default)]
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", schema(default))]
    pub priority: u32,
}

impl ResourceSpec for HaGroupSpec {
    const KIND: Kind = Kind::HaGroup;
    type Status = HaGroupStatus;
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
#[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", derive(utoipa::ToSchema))]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct HaGroupStatus {}

impl HaGroupSpec {
    /// 노드가 있는지는 저장소를 보는 API가 확인한다.
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), PlacementError> {
        if self.nodes.is_empty() {
            return Err(PlacementError::NoGroupNodes);
        }
        let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
        for n in &self.nodes {
            if validate_name(&n.node).is_err() {
                return Err(PlacementError::NodeName(n.node.clone()));
            }
            if !seen.insert(&n.node) {
                return Err(PlacementError::DuplicateNode(n.node.clone()));
            }
            if n.priority > MAX_PRIORITY {
                return Err(PlacementError::Priority(n.node.clone()));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// 이 노드의 그룹 우선순위. 그룹 밖이면 None이다.
    pub fn priority(&self, node: &str) -> Option<u32> {
        self.nodes
            .iter()
            .find(|n| n.node == node)
            .map(|n| n.priority)
    }
}

/// 배치 규칙: VM끼리(같은 노드·다른 노드) 또는 VM과 노드(이 노드들 중·이 노드들은 안 됨). hard 규칙은
/// 조건이고 soft 규칙은 벌점(`weight`)이다. 모든 VM에 적용한다.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", derive(utoipa::ToSchema))]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct PlacementRuleSpec {
    pub kind: RuleKind,
    /// 규칙의 VM 이름(아직 없는 VM이어도 된다). `vm_tag`와 둘 중 하나만.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", schema(default))]
    pub vms: Vec<String>,
    /// 이 레이블(`key=value`)을 가진 VM들
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[cfg_attr(
        feature = "openapi",
        schema(nullable = false, default, example = "app=web")
    )]
    pub vm_tag: Option<String>,
    /// VM과 노드 규칙의 노드 이름. `node_tag`와 둘 중 하나만.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", schema(default))]
    pub nodes: Vec<String>,
    /// 이 레이블(`key=value`, 예: `zone=rack-a`)을 가진 노드들
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[cfg_attr(
        feature = "openapi",
        schema(nullable = false, default, example = "zone=rack-a")
    )]
    pub node_tag: Option<String>,
    /// soft 규칙의 벌점 1~100. 없으면 50.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", schema(nullable = false, default))]
    pub weight: Option<u8>,
    /// 끄면 없는 것으로 본다.
    #[serde(default = "yes")]
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", schema(default = true))]
    pub enabled: bool,
    /// hard 규칙만: HA 복구가 지킬 수 없으면 어기고 켠다.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", schema(default))]
    pub ha_may_violate: bool,
}

fn yes() -> bool {
    true
}

impl ResourceSpec for PlacementRuleSpec {
    const KIND: Kind = Kind::PlacementRule;
    type Status = PlacementRuleStatus;
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
#[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", derive(utoipa::ToSchema))]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct PlacementRuleStatus {}

/// 배치 규칙의 종류
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", derive(utoipa::ToSchema))]
#[serde(rename_all = "kebab-case")]
pub enum RuleKind {
    /// 반드시 같은 노드
    Affinity,
    /// 반드시 서로 다른 노드
    AntiAffinity,
    /// 되도록 같은 노드
    SoftAffinity,
    /// 되도록 서로 다른 노드
    SoftAntiAffinity,
    /// 반드시 이 노드들 중
    NodeAffinity,
    /// 이 노드들은 안 됨
    NodeAntiAffinity,
    /// 되도록 이 노드들 중
    SoftNodeAffinity,
    /// 되도록 이 노드들은 피함
    SoftNodeAntiAffinity,
}

impl RuleKind {
    /// 반드시(hard) 규칙인지. 아니면 벌점(soft) 규칙이다.
    pub fn is_hard(self) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self,
            RuleKind::Affinity
                | RuleKind::AntiAffinity
                | RuleKind::NodeAffinity
                | RuleKind::NodeAntiAffinity
        )
    }

    /// VM끼리 규칙인지. 아니면 VM과 노드 규칙이다.
    pub fn is_vm_rule(self) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self,
            RuleKind::Affinity
                | RuleKind::AntiAffinity
                | RuleKind::SoftAffinity
                | RuleKind::SoftAntiAffinity
        )
    }

    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            RuleKind::Affinity => "affinity",
            RuleKind::AntiAffinity => "anti-affinity",
            RuleKind::SoftAffinity => "soft-affinity",
            RuleKind::SoftAntiAffinity => "soft-anti-affinity",
            RuleKind::NodeAffinity => "node-affinity",
            RuleKind::NodeAntiAffinity => "node-anti-affinity",
            RuleKind::SoftNodeAffinity => "soft-node-affinity",
            RuleKind::SoftNodeAntiAffinity => "soft-node-anti-affinity",
        }
    }
}

impl PlacementRuleSpec {
    /// 노드가 있는지는 저장소를 보는 API가 확인한다.
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), PlacementError> {
        let kind = self.kind.as_str();
        match (&self.vm_tag, self.vms.is_empty()) {
            (Some(_), false) | (None, true) => return Err(PlacementError::VmSelector),
            (Some(tag), true) => {
                parse_tag(tag).ok_or_else(|| PlacementError::Tag(tag.clone()))?;
            }
            (None, false) => {
                if self.kind.is_vm_rule() && self.vms.len() < 2 {
                    return Err(PlacementError::TooFewVms(kind));
                }
                check_names(
                    &self.vms,
                    PlacementError::VmName,
                    PlacementError::DuplicateVm,
                )?;
            }
        }
        if self.kind.is_vm_rule() {
            if !self.nodes.is_empty() || self.node_tag.is_some() {
                return Err(PlacementError::NodesOnVmRule(kind));
            }
        } else {
            match (&self.node_tag, self.nodes.is_empty()) {
                (Some(_), false) | (None, true) => return Err(PlacementError::NodeSelector(kind)),
                (Some(tag), true) => {
                    parse_tag(tag).ok_or_else(|| PlacementError::Tag(tag.clone()))?;
                }
                (None, false) => check_names(
                    &self.nodes,
                    PlacementError::NodeName,
                    PlacementError::DuplicateNode,
                )?,
            }
        }
        match self.weight {
            Some(_) if self.kind.is_hard() => return Err(PlacementError::WeightOnHard(kind)),
            Some(w) if !(1..=MAX_WEIGHT).contains(&w) => return Err(PlacementError::Weight),
            _ => {}
        }
        if self.ha_may_violate && !self.kind.is_hard() {
            return Err(PlacementError::HaMayViolateOnSoft(kind));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// soft 규칙의 벌점(없으면 [`DEFAULT_WEIGHT`])
    pub fn weight(&self) -> u32 {
        u32::from(self.weight.unwrap_or(DEFAULT_WEIGHT))
    }

    /// 이 이름·레이블의 VM이 규칙의 VM인지
    pub fn has_vm(&self, name: &str, labels: &BTreeMap<String, String>) -> bool {
        match &self.vm_tag {
            Some(tag) => tag_matches(tag, labels),
            None => self.vms.iter().any(|v| v == name),
        }
    }

    /// 이 이름·레이블의 노드가 규칙의 노드 집합에 드는지(VM과 노드 규칙)
    pub fn has_node(&self, name: &str, labels: &BTreeMap<String, String>) -> bool {
        match &self.node_tag {
            Some(tag) => tag_matches(tag, labels),
            None => self.nodes.iter().any(|n| n == name),
        }
    }
}

fn check_names(
    names: &[String],
    bad: fn(String) -> PlacementError,
    dup: fn(String) -> PlacementError,
) -> Result<(), PlacementError> {
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    for name in names {
        if validate_name(name).is_err() {
            return Err(bad(name.clone()));
        }
        if !seen.insert(name) {
            return Err(dup(name.clone()));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// 태그 `key=value`를 나눈다. 키가 비었거나 `=`가 없으면 None이다(값은 비어도 된다).
pub fn parse_tag(tag: &str) -> Option<(&str, &str)> {
    tag.split_once('=').filter(|(key, _)| !key.is_empty())
}

/// 레이블에 태그의 키가 있고 값이 같은지
pub fn tag_matches(tag: &str, labels: &BTreeMap<String, String>) -> bool {
    parse_tag(tag).is_some_and(|(key, value)| labels.get(key).is_some_and(|v| v == value))
}

#[derive(Debug, Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum PlacementError {
    #[error("nodes must not be empty")]
    NoGroupNodes,
    #[error("node {0:?} is not a valid node name")]
    NodeName(String),
    #[error("node {0:?} is listed more than once")]
    DuplicateNode(String),
    #[error("the priority of node {0:?} must be between 0 and {MAX_PRIORITY}")]
    Priority(String),
    #[error("give exactly one of vms and vm_tag")]
    VmSelector,
    #[error("{0} rules need at least two VMs")]
    TooFewVms(&'static str),
    #[error("VM {0:?} is not a valid VM name")]
    VmName(String),
    #[error("VM {0:?} is listed more than once")]
    DuplicateVm(String),
    #[error("tag {0:?} must be key=value")]
    Tag(String),
    #[error("{0} rules are between VMs; they take no nodes or node_tag")]
    NodesOnVmRule(&'static str),
    #[error("{0} rules need exactly one of nodes and node_tag")]
    NodeSelector(&'static str),
    #[error("weight is only for soft rules, not {0}")]
    WeightOnHard(&'static str),
    #[error("weight must be between 1 and {MAX_WEIGHT}")]
    Weight,
    #[error("ha_may_violate is only for hard rules, not {0}")]
    HaMayViolateOnSoft(&'static str),
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn rule(kind: RuleKind) -> PlacementRuleSpec {
        PlacementRuleSpec {
            kind,
            vms: vec!["a".into(), "b".into()],
            vm_tag: None,
            nodes: vec![],
            node_tag: None,
            weight: None,
            enabled: true,
            ha_may_violate: false,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn kinds_are_listed_by_their_str() {
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(Kind::HaGroup).unwrap(), "ha-group");
        assert_eq!(Kind::HaGroup.as_str(), "ha-group");
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::to_value(Kind::PlacementRule).unwrap(),
            "placement-rule"
        );
        assert_eq!(Kind::PlacementRule.as_str(), "placement-rule");
        for kind in [
            RuleKind::Affinity,
            RuleKind::AntiAffinity,
            RuleKind::SoftAffinity,
            RuleKind::SoftAntiAffinity,
            RuleKind::NodeAffinity,
            RuleKind::NodeAntiAffinity,
            RuleKind::SoftNodeAffinity,
            RuleKind::SoftNodeAntiAffinity,
        ] {
            assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(kind).unwrap(), kind.as_str());
            let hard = !kind.as_str().starts_with("soft-");
            let vm = !kind.as_str().contains("node");
            assert_eq!(kind.is_hard(), hard, "{kind:?}");
            assert_eq!(kind.is_vm_rule(), vm, "{kind:?}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn rule_fills_missing_fields_and_rejects_unknown() {
        let spec: PlacementRuleSpec = serde_json::from_value(
            serde_json::json!({ "kind": "anti-affinity", "vms": ["a", "b"] }),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(spec, rule(RuleKind::AntiAffinity));
        assert!(spec.enabled);
        assert_eq!(spec.weight(), u32::from(DEFAULT_WEIGHT));
        let json = serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            json,
            serde_json::json!({
                "kind": "anti-affinity",
                "vms": ["a", "b"],
                "nodes": [],
                "enabled": true,
                "ha_may_violate": false
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::from_value::<PlacementRuleSpec>(json).unwrap(),
            spec
        );
        for bad in [
            serde_json::json!({ "kind": "anti-affinity", "vms": ["a", "b"], "priority": 1 }),
            serde_json::json!({ "kind": "together", "vms": ["a", "b"] }),
            serde_json::json!({ "vms": ["a", "b"] }),
        ] {
            assert!(
                serde_json::from_value::<PlacementRuleSpec>(bad.clone()).is_err(),
                "{bad}"
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn group_fills_missing_fields_and_rejects_unknown() {
        let spec: HaGroupSpec =
            serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "n1" }] })).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            spec,
            HaGroupSpec {
                nodes: vec![HaGroupNode {
                    node: "n1".into(),
                    priority: 0
                }],
                restricted: false,
                nofailback: false,
            }
        );
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::from_value::<HaGroupSpec>(serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap()).unwrap(),
            spec
        );
        for bad in [
            serde_json::json!({ "nodes": [], "failback": true }),
            serde_json::json!({ "nodes": [{ "node": "n1", "weight": 1 }] }),
        ] {
            assert!(
                serde_json::from_value::<HaGroupSpec>(bad.clone()).is_err(),
                "{bad}"
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn validates_groups() {
        let group = |nodes: &[(&str, u32)]| HaGroupSpec {
            nodes: nodes
                .iter()
                .map(|(n, p)| HaGroupNode {
                    node: n.to_string(),
                    priority: *p,
                })
                .collect(),
            restricted: true,
            nofailback: false,
        };
        assert_eq!(group(&[("n1", 0), ("n2", MAX_PRIORITY)]).validate(), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(group(&[]).validate(), Err(PlacementError::NoGroupNodes));
        assert_eq!(
            group(&[("n1", 1), ("n1", 2)]).validate(),
            Err(PlacementError::DuplicateNode("n1".into()))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            group(&[("n1", MAX_PRIORITY + 1)]).validate(),
            Err(PlacementError::Priority("n1".into()))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            group(&[("N1", 1)]).validate(),
            Err(PlacementError::NodeName("N1".into()))
        );
        let g = group(&[("n1", 1), ("n2", 5)]);
        assert_eq!(g.priority("n2"), Some(5));
        assert_eq!(g.priority("n3"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn validates_rules() {
        assert_eq!(rule(RuleKind::Affinity).validate(), Ok(()));
        let with = |f: &dyn Fn(&mut PlacementRuleSpec), kind| {
            let mut r = rule(kind);
            f(&mut r);
            r.validate()
        };
        use PlacementError as E;
        use RuleKind as K;
        // VM 고르기는 둘 중 하나만
        assert_eq!(with(&|r| r.vms.clear(), K::Affinity), Err(E::VmSelector));
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.vm_tag = Some("app=web".into()), K::Affinity),
            Err(E::VmSelector)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(
                &|r| {
                    r.vms.clear();
                    r.vm_tag = Some("app=web".into());
                },
                K::Affinity
            ),
            Ok(())
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(
                &|r| {
                    r.vms.clear();
                    r.vm_tag = Some("app".into());
                },
                K::Affinity
            ),
            Err(E::Tag("app".into()))
        );
        // VM끼리 규칙의 목록은 둘 이상, 노드 규칙은 하나도 된다.
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.vms.truncate(1), K::AntiAffinity),
            Err(E::TooFewVms("anti-affinity"))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(
                &|r| {
                    r.vms.truncate(1);
                    r.nodes = vec!["n1".into()];
                },
                K::NodeAffinity
            ),
            Ok(())
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.vms[1] = "a".into(), K::Affinity),
            Err(E::DuplicateVm("a".into()))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.vms[1] = "B".into(), K::Affinity),
            Err(E::VmName("B".into()))
        );
        // VM끼리 규칙은 노드를 받지 않고, 노드 규칙은 노드 고르기 둘 중 하나만
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.nodes = vec!["n1".into()], K::SoftAffinity),
            Err(E::NodesOnVmRule("soft-affinity"))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.node_tag = Some("zone=a".into()), K::Affinity),
            Err(E::NodesOnVmRule("affinity"))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|_| {}, K::NodeAntiAffinity),
            Err(E::NodeSelector("node-anti-affinity"))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(
                &|r| {
                    r.nodes = vec!["n1".into()];
                    r.node_tag = Some("zone=a".into());
                },
                K::NodeAffinity
            ),
            Err(E::NodeSelector("node-affinity"))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.node_tag = Some("zone=a".into()), K::SoftNodeAffinity),
            Ok(())
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.node_tag = Some("=a".into()), K::NodeAffinity),
            Err(E::Tag("=a".into()))
        );
        // weight는 soft에만 1~100, ha_may_violate는 hard에만
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.weight = Some(10), K::AntiAffinity),
            Err(E::WeightOnHard("anti-affinity"))
        );
        assert_eq!(with(&|r| r.weight = Some(100), K::SoftAntiAffinity), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.weight = Some(0), K::SoftAntiAffinity),
            Err(E::Weight)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.weight = Some(101), K::SoftAffinity),
            Err(E::Weight)
        );
        assert_eq!(with(&|r| r.ha_may_violate = true, K::Affinity), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(
            with(&|r| r.ha_may_violate = true, K::SoftAffinity),
            Err(E::HaMayViolateOnSoft("soft-affinity"))
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn tags_match_labels_by_key_and_value() {
        assert_eq!(parse_tag("zone=rack-a"), Some(("zone", "rack-a")));
        assert_eq!(parse_tag("k=a=b"), Some(("k", "a=b")));
        assert_eq!(parse_tag("k="), Some(("k", "")));
        assert_eq!(parse_tag("zone"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_tag("=x"), None);
        let labels = BTreeMap::from([("zone".to_string(), "rack-a".to_string())]);
        assert!(tag_matches("zone=rack-a", &labels));
        assert!(!tag_matches("zone=rack-b", &labels));
        assert!(!tag_matches("rack=rack-a", &labels));

        let mut r = rule(RuleKind::NodeAffinity);
        r.vms.clear();
        r.vm_tag = Some("app=db".into());
        r.node_tag = Some("zone=rack-a".into());
        let db = BTreeMap::from([("app".to_string(), "db".to_string())]);
        assert!(r.has_vm("anything", &db));
        assert!(!r.has_vm("a", &BTreeMap::new()));
        assert!(r.has_node("n9", &labels));
        assert!(!r.has_node("n9", &BTreeMap::new()));
        let r = rule(RuleKind::Affinity);
        assert!(r.has_vm("a", &BTreeMap::new()));
        assert!(!r.has_vm("c", &db));
    }
}
```

을 다음으로 바꾼다:

```rust
            Kind::VipHolder,
            Kind::HaGroup,
            Kind::PlacementRule,
        ] {
```

`crates/oplctl/src/cli.rs` 전체:

```rust
//! 명령 정의와 실행.

use std::ffi::OsString;
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::PathBuf;

use anyhow::{Context, bail};
use clap::{ArgGroup, Args, Parser, Subcommand, ValueEnum};
use reqwest::Method;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

use crate::client::{

    UPGRADE_WAIT, fetch_ca, fingerprint, local, seg,
};
use crate::config::{CliConfig, default_path};
use crate::output::{bytes, cell, json as print_json, table};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(
    name = "orbivisorctl",
    version = opl_types::version::BUILD,
    about = "Orbivisor command-line client"
)]
struct Cli {
    /// 로그인 정보 파일 (기본: ~/.config/opl/oplctl.json)
    #[arg(long, global = true, env = "OPL_CONFIG")]
    config: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// API 주소. 로그인할 때 저장한 주소 대신 쓴다.
    #[arg(long, global = true, env = "OPL_SERVER")]
    server: Option<String>,
    #[arg(short, long, global = true, value_enum, default_value = "table")]
    output: Output,
    #[command(subcommand)]
    cmd: Cmd,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, ValueEnum)]
enum Output {
    Table,
    Json,
    /// HAProxy `server` 줄(`cluster api-endpoints`만)
    Haproxy,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Cmd {
    /// 로그인해 API 토큰을 만들고 저장한다.
    Login(LoginArgs),
    /// 저장한 API 토큰을 지운다(login이 만든 토큰 `oplctl-…`이면 서버에서도).
    Logout,
    /// 클러스터 만들기, 노드 합류와 탈퇴, 상태
    Cluster {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: ClusterCmd,
    },
    Node {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: NodeCmd,
    },
    Pool {
        #[command(subcommand)]

    },
    /// VM NIC가 연결하는 네트워크(노드에 미리 만든 Linux 브리지나 orbivisord가 만드는 VXLAN 네트워크)
    Network {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: NetworkCmd,
    },
    /// VM NIC에 거는 방화벽 규칙 묶음. nftables가 있는 노드가 적용한다.
    SecurityGroup {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: SecurityGroupCmd,
    },
    Volume {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: VolumeCmd,
    },
    Vm {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: VmCmd,
    },
    /// HA 그룹: HA VM을 놓고 복구할 노드와 우선순위
    HaGroup {
        #[command(subcommand)]
        cmd: HaGroupCmd,
    },
    /// 배치 규칙: VM끼리(같은 노드·다른 노드)나 VM과 노드(이 노드들 중·이 노드들은 안 됨). hard 규칙은
    /// 조건이고 soft 규칙은 벌점이다.
    PlacementRule {
        #[command(subcommand)]

        #[command(subcommand)]

    /// 백업 작업: 정한 시각(UTC)에 고른 VM들을 백업하고 보존 규칙대로 옛 백업을 지운다.
    BackupJob {

    Remote {

    },
}

#[derive(Args)]

    #[arg(long)]
    ca_fingerprint: Option<String>,
    /// 서버 인증서를 클러스터 CA 대신 OS 신뢰 저장소로 확인한다(관리자 인증서 `[api] tls_cert`를 둔 노드,

    #[arg(long, conflicts_with = "ca_fingerprint")]

/// 이 기계의 opld에 제어 소켓으로 보내는 명령의 공통 인자
#[derive(Args)]

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum ClusterCmd {
    /// 이 노드 하나로 새 클러스터를 만든다. 관리자 비밀번호와 다음 노드의 조인 URL을 출력한다.

    Get {

    },
    /// 노드의 업데이트 확인 결과(올릴 수 있는 패키지)를 보인다.
    Updates {
        node: String,
        /// 먼저 노드에서 다시 확인하고(Task가 끝날 때까지 기다린다) 결과를 보인다.

    /// 한 노드만 한다.

    Maintenance {

    Roles {

        roles: String,

    /// `zone=rack-a`)가 이 레이블을 본다.
    #[command(group(ArgGroup::new("change").required(true).multiple(true).args(["labels", "remove"])))]
    Label {
```
