```tsx
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { http, HttpResponse } from "msw";

import type { Node } from "@/api/types";
import { HaGroupsPage } from "@/ha-groups/HaGroupsPage";
import { haGroup, NODE, vm } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { ADMIN, mockLists, renderPage } from "@/test/render";
import { apiUrl, server } from "@/test/server";

function node(id: string, name: string, witness = false): Node {
  return { ...NODE, id, name, spec: { ...NODE.spec, witness } };
}

const NODES = [
  node("n1", "node-a"),
  node("n2", "node-b"),
  node("n3", "node-c"),
  node("w", "wit", true),
];
const OPERATOR = { ...ADMIN, name: "ops", role: "operator" as const };

const rack = haGroup("rack", 1, {
  nodes: [
    { node: "node-b", priority: 1 },
    { node: "node-a", priority: 2 },
  ],
  restricted: true,
});
const plain = haGroup("plain", 2, { nodes: [{ node: "node-c", priority: 0 }] });
const db = vm("db", "running", {
  spec: {
    ...vm("db", "running").spec,
    ha: { state: "started", group: "rack", max_restart: 1, max_relocate: 1 },
  },
});

function cells(table: HTMLElement, name: string) {
  const headers = within(table).getAllByRole("columnheader");
  const row = within(table).getByText(name).closest("tr")!;
  return (header: string) =>
    within(row).getAllByRole("cell")[headers.findIndex((h) => h.textContent === header)];
}

it("lists groups with their nodes by priority, options and VMs", async () => {
  mockLists({ "ha-group": [rack, plain], node: NODES, vm: [db, vm("web", "running")] });
  renderPage(<HaGroupsPage />);
  const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "HA groups" });
  await within(table).findByText("rack");
  const row = cells(table, "rack");
  // 우선순위가 높은 노드부터
  expect(row("Nodes and priority")).toHaveTextContent("node-a (2), node-b (1)");
  expect(row("Options")).toHaveTextContent("Restricted");
  expect(await within(row("VMs")!).findByText("db")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(cells(table, "plain")("Options")).toHaveTextContent("—");
  expect(cells(table, "plain")("VMs")).toHaveTextContent("—");
  // 이름 순
  expect(
    within(table)
      .getAllByRole("row")
      .map((r) => r.firstChild?.textContent),
  ).toEqual(["Name", "plain", "rack"]);
});

it("creates a group from the chosen nodes and priorities", async () => {
  mockLists({ "ha-group": [rack], node: NODES });
  let body: unknown;
  server.use(
    http.post(apiUrl("/ha-groups"), async ({ request }) => {
      body = await request.json();
      return HttpResponse.json(haGroup("new", 3), { status: 201 });
    }),
  );
  renderPage(<HaGroupsPage />);
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Create" }));
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Create HA group" });
  // 위트니스는 고를 수 없다.
  expect(within(dialog).queryByLabelText("wit")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  await user.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Name"), "rack");
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Create" }));
  expect(within(dialog).getByText("An HA group with this name already exists.")).toBeVisible();
  expect(within(dialog).getByText("Choose at least one node.")).toBeVisible();
  await user.clear(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Name"));
  await user.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Name"), "new");
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByLabelText("node-b"));
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByLabelText("node-c"));
  const priority = within(dialog).getByLabelText("Priority of node-c");
  await user.clear(priority);
  await user.type(priority, "1001");
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Create" }));
  expect(within(dialog).getByText("Priorities are whole numbers from 0 to 1000.")).toBeVisible();
  await user.clear(priority);
  await user.type(priority, "5");
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Only on the group's nodes"));
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Create" }));
  expect(await screen.findByText("HA group new created.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(body).toEqual({
    name: "new",
    spec: {
      nodes: [
        { node: "node-c", priority: 5 },
        { node: "node-b", priority: 0 },
      ],
      restricted: true,
      nofailback: false,
    },
  });
});

it("replaces a group with its revision and keeps unchanged groups from saving", async () => {
  mockLists({ "ha-group": [rack], node: NODES });
  const sent: { ifMatch: string | null; body: unknown }[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.put(apiUrl(`/ha-groups/${rack.id}`), async ({ request }) => {
      sent.push({ ifMatch: request.headers.get("If-Match"), body: await request.json() });
      return HttpResponse.json(rack);
    }),
  );
  renderPage(<HaGroupsPage />);
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Edit HA group rack" }));
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Edit rack" });
  expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("node-a")).toBeChecked();
  expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Priority of node-a")).toHaveValue("2");
  expect(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" })).toBeDisabled();
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByLabelText("No failback"));
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByLabelText("node-b"));
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  expect(await screen.findByText("HA group rack saved.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(sent).toEqual([
    {
      ifMatch: "1",
      body: {
        labels: {},
        spec: { nodes: [{ node: "node-a", priority: 2 }], restricted: true, nofailback: true },
      },
    },
  ]);
});

it("says why a group in use cannot be deleted", async () => {
  mockLists({ "ha-group": [rack], node: NODES, vm: [db] });
  server.use(
    http.delete(apiUrl(`/ha-groups/${rack.id}`), () =>
      HttpResponse.json(
        { code: "group_in_use", message: 'HA group "rack" is used by VM "db"' },
        { status: 409 },
      ),
    ),
  );
  renderPage(<HaGroupsPage />);
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Delete HA group rack" }));
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("alertdialog", { name: "Delete HA group rack?" });
  await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Delete" }));
  expect(await within(dialog).findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent(
    'The HA group is in use. Take the VMs out of the group first: HA group "rack" is used by VM "db"',
  );
});

it("lets only admins change groups", async () => {
  mockLists({ "ha-group": [rack], node: NODES });
  renderPage(<HaGroupsPage />, { as: OPERATOR });
  const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "HA groups" });
  await within(table).findByText("rack");
  expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: "Create" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: "Edit HA group rack" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
});
```

`web/src/ha-groups/HaGroupsPage.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { Pencil, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { type RefObject, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { api, call } from "@/api/client";
import { useList } from "@/api/live";
import type { HaGroup } from "@/api/types";
import { usePrincipal } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { can } from "@/auth/permissions";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ConfirmDialog";
import { Field } from "@/components/Field";
import { FormDialog } from "@/components/FormDialog";
import { ListPending } from "@/components/ListPending";
import { TableMessage } from "@/components/TableMessage";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import {
  byPriority,
  checkGroupForm,
  emptyGroupForm,
  type GroupForm,
  groupFormOf,
  groupSpecOf,
  groupVms,
  sameGroupSpec,
} from "@/ha-groups/groups";

/** HA 그룹: 목록과 만들기·바꾸기·지우기. 누구나 읽고 admin만 바꾼다. */
export function HaGroupsPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const me = usePrincipal();
  const groups = useList("ha-group");
  const nodes = useList("node");
  const vms = useList("vm");
  // 만들기는 `null`, 바꾸기는 그 그룹
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<HaGroup | null | undefined>(undefined);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<HaGroup | null>(null);
  const [deleteOpen, setDeleteOpen] = useState(false);
  const opener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const write = can(me.role, "write", "ha-group");
  const list = [...(groups.data ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h1 id="ha-groups-title" className="text-2xl font-semibold">
          {t("nav.haGroups")}
        </h1>
        {write && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            {/* 노드 목록을 읽어야 그룹 노드를 고른다. */}
            {!nodes.isSuccess && <ListPending error={nodes.error} />}
            <Button
              disabled={!nodes.isSuccess || !groups.isSuccess}
              onClick={(e) => {
                opener.current = e.currentTarget;
                setEditing(null);
              }}
            >
              <Plus />
              {t("common.create")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("haGroups.pageHint")}</p>
      <Table aria-labelledby="ha-groups-title">
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead>{t("common.name")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("haGroups.nodes")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("haGroups.options")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("haGroups.vms")}</TableHead>
            {write && (
              <TableHead>
                <span className="sr-only">{t("vms.actions")}</span>
              </TableHead>
            )}
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {list.length === 0 && (
            <TableMessage colSpan={write ? 5 : 4} query={groups} empty={t("haGroups.empty")} />
          )}
          {list.map((group) => {
            const users = groupVms(group, vms.data ?? []);
            return (
              <TableRow key={group.id}>
                <TableCell className="font-medium">{group.name}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {byPriority(group.spec.nodes)
                    .map((n) => t("haGroups.nodePriority", { node: n.node, n: n.priority ?? 0 }))
                    .join(", ")}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                    {group.spec.restricted && (
                      <Badge variant="outline">{t("haGroups.restricted")}</Badge>
                    )}
                    {group.spec.nofailback && (
                      <Badge variant="outline">{t("haGroups.nofailback")}</Badge>
                    )}
                    {!group.spec.restricted && !group.spec.nofailback && "—"}
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                {/* VM 목록을 다 읽기 전에는 모른다. */}
                <TableCell>{vms.isSuccess ? users.join(", ") || "—" : "—"}</TableCell>
                {write && (
                  <TableCell className="text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      aria-label={t("haGroups.editNamed", { name: group.name })}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        opener.current = e.currentTarget;
                        setEditing(group);
                      }}
                    >
                      <Pencil />
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      aria-label={t("haGroups.deleteNamed", { name: group.name })}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        opener.current = e.currentTarget;
                        setDeleting(group);
                        setDeleteOpen(true);
                      }}
                    >
                      <Trash2 />
                    </Button>
                  </TableCell>
                )}
              </TableRow>
            );
          })}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
      {editing !== undefined && (
        <GroupDialog
          group={editing}
          taken={(groups.data ?? []).map((g) => g.name)}
          returnFocus={opener}
          onClose={() => setEditing(undefined)}
        />
      )}
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={deleteOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDeleteOpen}
        returnFocus={opener}
        title={t("haGroups.deleteTitle", { name: deleting?.name })}
        description={t("haGroups.deleteDescription")}
        confirmLabel={t("common.delete")}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          const group = deleting!;
          await call(api.DELETE("/ha-groups/{key}", { params: { path: { key: group.id } } }));
          toast.success(t("haGroups.deleted", { name: group.name }));
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** 그룹 만들기(`group`이 null)와 바꾸기. 열 때만 그린다. */
function GroupDialog({
  group,
  taken,
  returnFocus,
  onClose,
}: {
  group: HaGroup | null;
  /** 있는 그룹 이름 */
  taken: string[];
  returnFocus: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  onClose(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  // 위트니스는 VM을 돌리지 않는다. 지운 노드가 그룹에 남아 있으면 그 이름도 보인다(서버가 저장할 때 거절한다).
  const names = (useList("node").data ?? []).filter((n) => !n.spec.witness).map((n) => n.name);
  for (const n of group?.spec.nodes ?? []) {
    if (!names.includes(n.node)) {
      names.push(n.node);
    }
  }
  names.sort();
  const [form, setForm] = useState<GroupForm>(() =>
    group ? groupFormOf(group) : emptyGroupForm(),
  );
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const change = (part: Partial<GroupForm>) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, ...part }));
  const unchanged = group !== null && sameGroupSpec(group.spec, groupSpecOf(form));

  function toggle(node: string, on: boolean) {
    const nodes = { ...form.nodes };
    if (on) {
      nodes[node] = "0";
    } else {
      delete nodes[node];
    }
    change({ nodes });
  }

  async function submit() {
    const found = checkGroupForm(form, group ? null : taken);
    setErrors(found);
    if (Object.keys(found).length > 0) {
      return false;
    }
    if (group) {
      await call(
        api.PUT("/ha-groups/{key}", {
          params: { path: { key: group.id }, header: { "If-Match": group.revision } },
          body: { labels: group.labels, spec: groupSpecOf(form) },
        }),
      );
      toast.success(t("haGroups.saved", { name: group.name }));
    } else {
      await call(api.POST("/ha-groups", { body: { name: form.name, spec: groupSpecOf(form) } }));
      toast.success(t("haGroups.created", { name: form.name }));
    }
  }

  return (
    <FormDialog
      title={group ? t("haGroups.editTitle", { name: group.name }) : t("haGroups.createTitle")}
      description={t("haGroups.dialogDescription")}
      submitLabel={group ? t("common.save") : t("common.create")}
      submitDisabled={unchanged}
      returnFocus={returnFocus}
      onClose={onClose}
      onSubmit={submit}
    >
      {!group && (
        <Field id="group-name" label={t("common.name")} error={errors.name}>
          {(a11y) => (
            <Input
              id="group-name"
              value={form.name}
              onChange={(e) => change({ name: e.target.value })}
              {...a11y}
            />
          )}
        </Field>
      )}
      <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <legend className="mb-1.5 text-sm font-medium">{t("haGroups.nodes")}</legend>
        {names.map((node) => {
          const on = node in form.nodes;
          return (
            <div key={node} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Checkbox
                id={`group-node-${node}`}
                checked={on}
                onCheckedChange={(v) => toggle(node, v === true)}
              />
              <Label htmlFor={`group-node-${node}`} className="min-w-24">
                {node}
              </Label>
              {on && (
                <Input
                  className="w-24"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  placeholder="0"
                  aria-label={t("haGroups.priorityOf", { node })}
                  aria-invalid={errors.nodes ? true : undefined}
                  value={form.nodes[node]}
                  onChange={(e) => change({ nodes: { ...form.nodes, [node]: e.target.value } })}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {errors.nodes ? (
          <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{t(errors.nodes)}</p>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("haGroups.nodesHint")}</p>
        )}
      </fieldset>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Checkbox
            id="group-restricted"
            checked={form.restricted}
            onCheckedChange={(on) => change({ restricted: on === true })}
          />
          <Label htmlFor="group-restricted">{t("haGroups.restrictedLabel")}</Label>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("haGroups.restrictedHint")}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Checkbox
            id="group-nofailback"
            checked={form.nofailback}
            onCheckedChange={(on) => change({ nofailback: on === true })}
          />
          <Label htmlFor="group-nofailback">{t("haGroups.nofailbackLabel")}</Label>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("haGroups.nofailbackHint")}</p>
      </div>
    </FormDialog>
  );
}
```

`web/src/ha-groups/groups.ts`를 만든다:

```ts
import type { HaGroup, Vm } from "@/api/types";
import { validName } from "@/vms/form";

type Spec = HaGroup["spec"];

/** 서버의 `MAX_PRIORITY` */
export const MAX_PRIORITY = 1000;

/** 만들기·바꾸기 폼의 값. 우선순위는 입력 그대로 문자열로 둔다. */
export interface GroupForm {
  name: string;
  /** 노드 이름 → 우선순위 입력. 고른 노드만 들어 있다. */
  nodes: Record<string, string>;
  restricted: boolean;
  nofailback: boolean;
}

export function emptyGroupForm(): GroupForm {
  return { name: "", nodes: {}, restricted: false, nofailback: false };
}

export function groupFormOf(group: HaGroup): GroupForm {
  return {
    name: group.name,
    nodes: Object.fromEntries(group.spec.nodes.map((n) => [n.node, String(n.priority ?? 0)])),
    restricted: group.spec.restricted ?? false,
    nofailback: group.spec.nofailback ?? false,
  };
}

/** 서버와 같은 검사. 오류는 필드별 번역 키다. `taken`은 다른 그룹의 이름이고 바꾸기면 null(이름 없음). */
export function checkGroupForm(form: GroupForm, taken: string[] | null): Record<string, string> {
  const found: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (taken !== null) {
    if (!validName(form.name)) {
      found.name = "forms.name";
    } else if (taken.includes(form.name)) {
      found.name = "haGroups.errors.exists";
    }
  }
  const priorities = Object.values(form.nodes);
  if (priorities.length === 0) {
    found.nodes = "haGroups.errors.nodes";
  } else if (
    priorities.some(
      (p) => p.trim() !== "" && !(/^\d+$/.test(p.trim()) && Number(p) <= MAX_PRIORITY),
    )
  ) {
    found.nodes = "haGroups.errors.priority";
  }
  return found;
}

/** 우선순위가 높은 노드부터(같으면 이름 순). 화면과 저장이 같은 순서를 쓴다. */
export function byPriority(nodes: Spec["nodes"]): Spec["nodes"] {
  return [...nodes].sort(
    (a, b) => (b.priority ?? 0) - (a.priority ?? 0) || a.node.localeCompare(b.node),
  );
}

/** 검사한 폼의 스펙. 빈 우선순위는 0이다. */
export function groupSpecOf(form: GroupForm): Spec {
  const nodes = Object.entries(form.nodes).map(([node, p]) => ({
    node,
    priority: Number(p.trim() || "0"),
  }));
  return { nodes: byPriority(nodes), restricted: form.restricted, nofailback: form.nofailback };
}

/** 같은 스펙인지(노드 순서는 보지 않는다). 바꾼 것이 없으면 저장 버튼을 막는다. */
export function sameGroupSpec(a: Spec, b: Spec): boolean {
  const norm = (s: Spec) =>
    JSON.stringify([
      byPriority(s.nodes).map((n) => [n.node, n.priority ?? 0]),
      s.restricted ?? false,
      s.nofailback ?? false,
    ]);
  return norm(a) === norm(b);
}

/** 그룹을 쓰는 VM(`ha.group`) 이름. 쓰는 VM이 있으면 서버가 삭제를 거절한다(409 `group_in_use`). */
export function groupVms(group: HaGroup, vms: readonly Vm[]): string[] {
  return vms
    .filter((vm) => typeof vm.spec.ha === "object" && vm.spec.ha.group === group.name)
    .map((vm) => vm.name)
    .sort();
}
```

```tsx
it("edits node labels with the revision of the node when saving", async () => {
  cluster();
  const labeled = { ...DOWN, labels: { zone: "rack-a" } };
  mockLists({ node: [NODE, labeled] });
  const sent: { ifMatch: string | null; body: unknown }[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.put(apiUrl("/nodes/n2"), async ({ request }) => {
      const body = (await request.json()) as { labels: Record<string, string> };
      sent.push({ ifMatch: request.headers.get("If-Match"), body });
      return HttpResponse.json({ ...labeled, revision: 10, labels: body.labels });
    }),
  );
  const { queryClient } = renderPage(<NodesPage />);
  const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "Nodes" });
  await within(table).findByText("node-b");
  const labelsColumn = within(table)
    .getAllByRole("columnheader")
    .findIndex((h) => h.textContent === "Labels");
  const row = (name: string) => within(table).getByText(name).closest("tr")!;
  expect(within(row("node-b")).getAllByRole("cell")[labelsColumn]).toHaveTextContent("zone=rack-a");
  expect(within(row("node-a")).getAllByRole("cell")[labelsColumn]).toHaveTextContent("—");
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Actions for node-b" }));
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Edit labels" }));
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Labels of node-b" });
  const input = within(dialog).getByLabelText("Labels");
  expect(input).toHaveValue("zone=rack-a");
  expect(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" })).toBeDisabled();
  await userEvent.type(input, ", ssd");
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  expect(within(dialog).getByText("Use KEY=VALUE pairs separated by commas.")).toBeVisible();
  await userEvent.type(input, "=true");
  // 대화 상자를 연 사이 노드 status가 바뀌어 revision이 올랐다.
  const bumped = { ...labeled, revision: 9, status: { ...labeled.status, cpus: 16 } };
  act(() => {
    queryClient.setQueryData<List<Node>>(
      listKey("node"),
      (list) => list && applyEvent(list, { type: "put", kind: "node", resource: bumped }),
    );
  });
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  expect(await screen.findByText("Labels of node-b saved.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(sent).toEqual([
    { ifMatch: "9", body: { labels: { zone: "rack-a", ssd: "true" }, spec: DOWN.spec } },
  ]);
  // 응답을 곧바로 목록에 반영한다.
  expect(within(row("node-b")).getAllByRole("cell")[labelsColumn]).toHaveTextContent(
    "ssd=true, zone=rack-a",
  );
});

it("does not overwrite node labels changed while the dialog was open", async () => {
  cluster();
  const labeled = { ...DOWN, labels: { zone: "rack-a" } };
  mockLists({ node: [NODE, labeled] });
  const sent: unknown[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.put(apiUrl("/nodes/n2"), async ({ request }) => {
      sent.push(await request.json());
      return HttpResponse.json(labeled);
    }),
  );
  const { queryClient } = renderPage(<NodesPage />);
  const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "Nodes" });
  await within(table).findByText("node-b");
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Actions for node-b" }));
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Edit labels" }));
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Labels of node-b" });
  await userEvent.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Labels"), ", ssd=true");
  // 대화 상자를 연 사이 다른 곳에서 레이블을 바꿨다.
  const relabeled = { ...labeled, revision: 9, labels: { zone: "rack-b" } };
  act(() => {
    queryClient.setQueryData<List<Node>>(
      listKey("node"),
      (list) => list && applyEvent(list, { type: "put", kind: "node", resource: relabeled }),
    );
  });
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  expect(
    within(dialog).getByText(
      "The labels of this node changed elsewhere. Close this dialog and open it again.",
    ),
  ).toBeVisible();
  expect(sent).toEqual([]);
});

it("marks a frozen node and unfreezes it", async () => {
  cluster();
  const frozen = {
    ...DOWN,
    status: { ...DOWN.status, shutdown: { action: "freeze" as const, at: 1_800_000_000 } },
  };
  // 켜져 있는 노드의 표시는 얼림이 아니다(곧 스스로 지운다).
  const back = {
    ...NODE,
    status: { ...NODE.status, shutdown: { action: "freeze" as const, at: 1_800_000_000 } },
  };
  mockLists({ node: [back, frozen] });
  let unfrozen = 0;
  server.use(
    http.post(apiUrl("/nodes/n2/unfreeze"), () => {
      unfrozen += 1;
      return unfrozen === 1
        ? HttpResponse.json(
            { code: "node_online", message: 'node "node-b" is online' },
            { status: 409 },
          )
        : HttpResponse.json(DOWN);
    }),
  );
  renderPage(<NodesPage />);
  const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "Nodes" });
  expect((await within(table).findByText("node-b")).closest("tr")).toHaveTextContent("Frozen");
  expect(within(table).getByText("node-a").closest("tr")).not.toHaveTextContent("Frozen");
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Actions for node-a" }));
  expect(await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Edit labels" })).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.queryByRole("menuitem", { name: "Unfreeze" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  await userEvent.keyboard("{Escape}");
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Actions for node-b" }));
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Unfreeze" }));
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("alertdialog", { name: "Unfreeze node-b?" });
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Unfreeze" }));
  expect(await within(dialog).findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent(
    "The node is online again; it clears the mark itself.",
  );
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Unfreeze" }));
  expect(
    await screen.findByText("node-b unfrozen. Its HA VMs are recovered on other nodes."),
  ).toBeInTheDocument();
});
```

`web/src/nodes/NodesPage.tsx` 전체:

```tsx
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { MoreHorizontal } from "lucide-react";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { ApiError, api, call } from "@/api/client";
import { applyEvent, listKey, useList, type List } from "@/api/live";
import { useTaskIndex } from "@/api/taskIndex";
import type { Node, Vm } from "@/api/types";
import { usePrincipal } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { can } from "@/auth/permissions";
import { parseLabels } from "@/backups/jobs";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ConfirmDialog";
import { Field } from "@/components/Field";
import { FormDialog } from "@/components/FormDialog";
import { ReasonMenuItem } from "@/components/Reason";
import { TableMessage } from "@/components/TableMessage";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { codeMessage, errorMessage } from "@/i18n/errors";
import { formatCapacity } from "@/lib/format";
import { NodeUpdatesDialog } from "@/nodes/NodeUpdatesDialog";
import { PoolStatus } from "@/storage/PoolStatus";
import { trackTask } from "@/tasks/tasks";

/** 그 노드에 고정했거나 그 노드에서 마지막으로 돈 VM의 수 */
function vmCount(node: Node, vms: Vm[]): number {
  return vms.filter((vm) => (vm.spec.node ?? vm.status.node) === node.id).length;
}

/** 비우기가 옮길 VM의 수: 그 노드에 고정돼 켜 둔 VM(서버의 비우기 Task와 같은 기준) */
function runningCount(node: Node, vms: Vm[]): number {
  return vms.filter((vm) => vm.spec.node === node.id && vm.spec.power === "running").length;
}

/** 서버의 `NodeStatus::frozen`: 종료 정책 `freeze`로 꺼진 채 돌아오지 않은 노드. 리더가 HA VM을 옮기지 않는다. */
function isFrozen(node: Node): boolean {
  return !node.status.online && node.status.shutdown?.action === "freeze";
}

/** 레이블을 `KEY=VALUE, …`로(키 순서) */
function labelText(labels: Node["labels"]): string {
  return Object.entries(labels ?? {})
    .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
    .map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`)
    .join(", ");
}

/** 배지 버튼의 접근 이름에 넣는 확인 상태 */
function updatesState(
  t: ReturnType<typeof useTranslation>["t"],
  updates: NonNullable<Node["status"]["updates"]>,
): string {
  if (updates.error) {
    return t("nodes.updates.stateFailed");
  }
  if (!updates.checked_at) {
    return t("nodes.updates.stateNotChecked");
  }
  return t("nodes.updates.stateCount", {
    n: `${updates.packages.length}${updates.truncated ? "+" : ""}`,
  });
}

/** 올릴 수 있는 패키지 수. 확인이 실패했으면 경고, 아직 확인하지 않았으면 비어 있다. */
function UpdatesBadge({ updates }: { updates: NonNullable<Node["status"]["updates"]> }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  if (updates.error) {
    return <Badge variant="destructive">{t("nodes.updates.failedBadge")}</Badge>;
  }
  if (!updates.checked_at) {
    return <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>;
  }
  const count = `${updates.packages.length}${updates.truncated ? "+" : ""}`;
  return <Badge variant={updates.packages.length > 0 ? "default" : "outline"}>{count}</Badge>;
}

export function NodesPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const me = usePrincipal();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const nodes = useList("node");
  const vms = useList("vm");
  const cluster = useQuery({ queryKey: ["cluster"], queryFn: () => call(api.GET("/cluster")) });
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<Node | null>(null);
  const [showingUpdates, setShowingUpdates] = useState<Node | null>(null);
  const [draining, setDraining] = useState<Node | null>(null);
  const [ending, setEnding] = useState<Node | null>(null);
  const [labeling, setLabeling] = useState<Node | null>(null);
  const [unfreezing, setUnfreezing] = useState<Node | null>(null);
  const tasks = useTaskIndex();
  /** 그 노드의 비우기 Task가 끝나지 않았는지 */
  const isDraining = (node: Node) =>
    (tasks.get(node.id) ?? []).some((task) => task.spec.op.kind === "node-drain");
  // 메뉴에서 연 대화상자를 닫으면 메뉴 항목이 사라지므로, 메뉴를 연 버튼으로 포커스를 돌린다.
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const rememberTrigger = (e: React.SyntheticEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    trigger.current = e.currentTarget;
  };
  const write = can(me.role, "write", "node");

  async function setMaintenance(node: Node, maintenance: boolean) {
    try {
      const updated = await call(
        api.PUT("/nodes/{key}", {
          params: { path: { key: node.id }, header: { "If-Match": node.revision } },
          body: { labels: node.labels, spec: { ...node.spec, maintenance } },
        }),
      );
      // watch 이벤트보다 먼저 반영한다(곧바로 다시 바꿔도 새 revision으로 보낸다).
      queryClient.setQueryData<List<Node>>(
        listKey("node"),
        (list) => list && applyEvent(list, { type: "put", kind: "node", resource: updated }),
      );
      toast.success(
        t(maintenance ? "nodes.maintenanceOn" : "nodes.maintenanceOff", { name: node.name }),
      );
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(t("vms.actionFailed", { name: node.name, error: errorMessage(t, err) }));
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <h1 id="nodes-title" className="text-2xl font-semibold">
        {t("nav.nodes")}
      </h1>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("nodes.joinNote")}</p>
      <Table aria-labelledby="nodes-title">
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead>{t("common.name")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("common.state")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.address")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.version")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.updates.column")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.underlay")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.hypervisor")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.arch")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.fencing")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.cpus")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.memory")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.bridges")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.pools")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.labels")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("nodes.vms")}</TableHead>
            {write && (
              <TableHead>
                <span className="sr-only">{t("vms.actions")}</span>
              </TableHead>
            )}
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {(nodes.data ?? []).length === 0 && (
            <TableMessage colSpan={write ? 16 : 15} query={nodes} empty={t("dashboard.noNodes")} />
          )}
          {(nodes.data ?? []).map((node) => (
            <TableRow key={node.id}>
              <TableCell className="font-medium">
                {node.name}
                {node.id === cluster.data?.node && (
                  <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("nodes.thisNode")}</span>
                )}
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  <Badge variant={node.status.online ? "default" : "destructive"}>
                    {t(node.status.online ? "dashboard.nodeOnline" : "dashboard.nodeOffline")}
                  </Badge>
                  {node.spec.maintenance && (
                    <Badge variant="outline">{t("dashboard.maintenance")}</Badge>
                  )}
                  {node.spec.witness && <Badge variant="outline">{t("dashboard.witness")}</Badge>}
                  {/* 리더는 얼린 노드의 HA VM을 옮기지 않는다(돌아오면 그 노드에서 켠다). */}
                  {isFrozen(node) && <Badge variant="secondary">{t("nodes.frozen")}</Badge>}
                </div>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{node.spec.address}</TableCell>
              {/* 옛 버전으로 등록한 노드는 모른다. */}
              <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{node.status.version ?? "—"}</TableCell>
              {/* 업데이트를 확인하지 않는 노드(위트니스, 꺼 둔 노드)는 `updates`가 없다. */}
              <TableCell>
                {node.status.updates ? (
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    aria-label={t("nodes.updates.open", {
                      name: node.name,
                      state: updatesState(t, node.status.updates),
                    })}
                    onPointerDown={rememberTrigger}
                    onKeyDown={rememberTrigger}
                    onClick={() => setShowingUpdates(node)}
                  >
                    <UpdatesBadge updates={node.status.updates} />
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  "—"
                )}
              </TableCell>
              {/* VXLAN 패킷을 주고받는 주소. 위트니스와 정하지 못한 노드는 없다. */}
              <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{node.status.underlay ?? "—"}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{node.status.hypervisor}</TableCell>
              {/* 옛 버전으로 등록한 노드는 모른다. */}
              <TableCell>{node.status.arch ?? "—"}</TableCell>
              {/* 펜싱이 꺼진 노드(위트니스 포함)는 HA VM을 돌리지 않는다. */}
              <TableCell>
                {node.status.ha ? t(`nodes.fencingMode.${node.status.ha.fencing}`) : "—"}
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>{node.status.cpus}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{formatCapacity(node.status.memory_mib)}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">
                {node.status.bridges.map((b) => b.name).join(", ") || "—"}
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                {Object.keys(node.status.pools).length === 0
                  ? "—"
                  : Object.entries(node.status.pools)
                      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
                      .map(([name, state]) => (
                        <PoolStatus
                          key={name}
                          name={name}
                          state={state}
                          offline={!node.status.online}
                        />
                      ))}
              </TableCell>
              {/* 배치 규칙의 노드 태그(`zone=rack-a`)가 보는 레이블 */}
              <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{labelText(node.labels) || "—"}</TableCell>
              {/* VM 목록을 다 읽기 전에는 모른다. */}
              <TableCell>{vms.isSuccess ? vmCount(node, vms.data) : "—"}</TableCell>
              {write && (
                <TableCell className="text-right">
                  <DropdownMenu modal={false}>
                    <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon-sm"
                        aria-label={t("vms.actionsFor", { name: node.name })}
                        onPointerDown={rememberTrigger}
                        onKeyDown={rememberTrigger}
                      >
                        <MoreHorizontal />
                      </Button>
                    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                    <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
                      <DropdownMenuItem
                        onSelect={() =>
                          // 유지보수를 끝내면 진행 중인 비우기가 멈추므로 먼저 묻는다.
                          node.spec.maintenance && isDraining(node)
                            ? setEnding(node)
                            : void setMaintenance(node, !node.spec.maintenance)
                        }
                      >
                        {t(
                          node.spec.maintenance ? "nodes.endMaintenance" : "nodes.startMaintenance",
                        )}
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      {/* 위트니스는 VM을 돌리지 않는다. */}
                      {!node.spec.witness && (
                        <ReasonMenuItem
                          reason={
                            !node.status.online
                              ? "nodes.drain.reason.offline"
                              : node.status.hypervisor === "qemu-hvf"
                                ? "nodes.drain.reason.hvf"
                                : isDraining(node)
                                  ? "nodes.drain.reason.draining"
                                  : null
                          }
                          onSelect={() => setDraining(node)}
                        >
                          {t("nodes.drain.menu")}
                        </ReasonMenuItem>
                      )}
                      {node.status.updates && (
                        <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setShowingUpdates(node)}>
                          {t("nodes.updates.menu")}
                        </DropdownMenuItem>
                      )}
                      <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setLabeling(node)}>
                        {t("nodes.labelsMenu")}
                      </DropdownMenuItem>
                      {isFrozen(node) && (
                        <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => setUnfreezing(node)}>
                          {t("nodes.unfreeze.menu")}
                        </DropdownMenuItem>
                      )}
                      <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                      <ReasonMenuItem
                        variant="destructive"
                        // 살아 있는 노드는 그 노드에서 `oplctl cluster leave`로 뺀다(서버도 막는다).
                        reason={
                          node.id === cluster.data?.node
                            ? "nodes.reason.thisNode"
                            : node.status.online
                              ? "nodes.reason.online"
                              : null
                        }
                        onSelect={() => setRemoving(node)}
                      >
                        {t("nodes.remove")}
                      </ReasonMenuItem>
                    </DropdownMenuContent>
                  </DropdownMenu>
                </TableCell>
              )}
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
      {write && (
        <>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("nodes.maintenanceNote")}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("nodes.removeNote")}</p>
        </>
      )}
      {showingUpdates && (
        <NodeUpdatesDialog
          node={showingUpdates}
          returnFocus={trigger}
          onClose={() => setShowingUpdates(null)}
        />
      )}
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={draining !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setDraining(null)}
        title={t("nodes.drain.title", { name: draining?.name })}
        description={t("nodes.drain.description")}
        confirmLabel={t("nodes.drain.confirm")}
        returnFocus={trigger}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          const node = draining!;
          try {
            const task = await call(
              api.POST("/nodes/{key}/drain", { params: { path: { key: node.id } } }),
            );
            trackTask(task, t("tasks.op.node-drain", { target: node.name }));
          } catch (err) {
            throw new Error(
              err instanceof ApiError
                ? codeMessage(t, err.code, err.message, "nodes.drain.errors")
                : errorMessage(t, err),
              { cause: err },
            );
          }
        }}
      >
        {/* VM 목록을 다 읽기 전에는 세지 않는다. */}
        {draining && vms.isSuccess && (
          <p className="text-sm">
            {t("nodes.drain.running", { count: runningCount(draining, vms.data) })}
          </p>
        )}
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("nodes.drain.localNote")}</p>
      </ConfirmDialog>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={ending !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setEnding(null)}
        title={t("nodes.drain.endTitle", { name: ending?.name })}
        description={t("nodes.drain.endDescription")}
        confirmLabel={t("nodes.endMaintenance")}
        returnFocus={trigger}
        onConfirm={() => setMaintenance(ending!, false)}
      />
      {labeling && (
        <LabelsDialog node={labeling} returnFocus={trigger} onClose={() => setLabeling(null)} />
      )}
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={unfreezing !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setUnfreezing(null)}
        title={t("nodes.unfreeze.title", { name: unfreezing?.name })}
        description={t("nodes.unfreeze.description")}
        confirmLabel={t("nodes.unfreeze.confirm")}
        returnFocus={trigger}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          const node = unfreezing!;
          try {
            await call(api.POST("/nodes/{key}/unfreeze", { params: { path: { key: node.id } } }));
          } catch (err) {
            throw new Error(
              err instanceof ApiError
                ? codeMessage(t, err.code, err.message, "nodes.unfreeze.errors")
                : errorMessage(t, err),
              { cause: err },
            );
          }
          toast.success(t("nodes.unfreeze.done", { name: node.name }));
        }}
      />
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={removing !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setRemoving(null)}
        title={t("nodes.removeTitle", { name: removing?.name })}
        description={t("nodes.removeDescription")}
        confirmLabel={t("nodes.remove")}
        typeToConfirm={removing?.name}
        returnFocus={trigger}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          const node = removing!;
          await call(api.DELETE("/nodes/{key}", { params: { path: { key: node.id } } }));
          toast.success(t("nodes.removed", { name: node.name }));
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** 노드 레이블 고치기. 열 때만 그린다. 배치 규칙의 `node_tag`(예: `zone=rack-a`)가 이 레이블을 본다. */
function LabelsDialog({
  node,
  returnFocus,
  onClose,
}: {
  node: Node;
  returnFocus: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  onClose(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [text, setText] = useState(() => labelText(node.labels));
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | undefined>();
  const parsed = parseLabels(text);
  const unchanged = parsed !== null && labelText(parsed) === labelText(node.labels);

  async function submit() {
    if (parsed === null) {
      setError("nodes.errors.labels");
      return false;
    }
    // 노드 status가 자주 바뀌어 revision이 오르므로 연 때가 아니라 저장할 때의 실시간 목록에 있는 노드로 쓴다.
    const current =
      queryClient.getQueryData<List<Node>>(listKey("node"))?.items.find((n) => n.id === node.id) ??
      node;
    // 연 사이 다른 곳에서 레이블이 바뀌었으면 덮지 않는다.
    if (labelText(current.labels) !== labelText(node.labels)) {
      setError("nodes.errors.labelsChanged");
      return false;
    }
    const updated = await call(
      api.PUT("/nodes/{key}", {
        params: { path: { key: node.id }, header: { "If-Match": current.revision } },
        body: { labels: parsed, spec: current.spec },
      }),
    );
    queryClient.setQueryData<List<Node>>(
      listKey("node"),
      (list) => list && applyEvent(list, { type: "put", kind: "node", resource: updated }),
    );
    toast.success(t("nodes.labelsSaved", { name: node.name }));
  }

  return (
    <FormDialog
      title={t("nodes.labelsTitle", { name: node.name })}
      description={t("nodes.labelsDescription")}
      submitLabel={t("common.save")}
      submitDisabled={unchanged}
      returnFocus={returnFocus}
      onClose={onClose}
      onSubmit={submit}
    >
      <Field id="node-labels" label={t("nodes.labels")} error={error} hint={t("nodes.labelsHint")}>
        {(a11y) => (
          <Input
            id="node-labels"
            placeholder="zone=rack-a, ssd=true"
            value={text}
            onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
            {...a11y}
          />
        )}
      </Field>
    </FormDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";

import { PlacementRulesPage } from "@/placement/PlacementRulesPage";
import { NODE, placementRule } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { ADMIN, mockLists, renderPage } from "@/test/render";
import { apiUrl, server } from "@/test/server";

function node(id: string, name: string): Node {
  return { ...NODE, id, name };
}

const NODES = [node("n1", "node-a"), node("n2", "node-b")];
const VIEWER = { ...ADMIN, name: "viewer", role: "viewer" as const };

const spread = placementRule("spread", 1);
const zone = placementRule("zone", 2, {
  kind: "node-affinity",
  vms: undefined,
  vm_tag: "app=db",
  node_tag: "zone=rack-a",
  ha_may_violate: true,
});
const prefer = placementRule("prefer", 3, {
  kind: "soft-node-affinity",
  vms: ["web1"],
  nodes: ["node-b"],
  weight: 20,
  enabled: false,
});

function cells(table: HTMLElement, name: string) {
  const headers = within(table).getAllByRole("columnheader");
  const row = within(table).getByText(name).closest("tr")!;
  return (header: string) =>
    within(row).getAllByRole("cell")[headers.findIndex((h) => h.textContent === header)];
}

it("lists rules with their kind, VMs, nodes, weight and state", async () => {
  mockLists({ "placement-rule": [zone, spread, prefer], node: NODES });
  renderPage(<PlacementRulesPage />);
  const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "Placement rules" });
  await within(table).findByText("spread");
  const s = cells(table, "spread");
  expect(s("Rule")).toHaveTextContent("Different nodes (hard)");
  expect(s("VMs")).toHaveTextContent("web1, web2");
  expect(s("Nodes")).toHaveTextContent("—");
  expect(s("Weight")).toHaveTextContent("—");
  expect(s("State")).toHaveTextContent("On");
  const z = cells(table, "zone");
  expect(z("VMs")).toHaveTextContent("app=db");
  expect(z("Nodes")).toHaveTextContent("zone=rack-a");
  expect(z("State")).toHaveTextContent("OnHA may break");
  const p = cells(table, "prefer");
  expect(p("Rule")).toHaveTextContent("On these nodes if possible");
  expect(p("Weight")).toHaveTextContent("20");
  expect(p("State")).toHaveTextContent("Off");
});

it("creates a node rule chosen by node label and sends only what the kind takes", async () => {

it("shows a contradiction the server finds", async () => {
```

```tsx
import { Pencil, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { type RefObject, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { api, call } from "@/api/client";
import { useList } from "@/api/live";
import type { PlacementRule, RuleKind } from "@/api/types";
import { usePrincipal } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { can } from "@/auth/permissions";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ConfirmDialog";
import { Field } from "@/components/Field";
import { FormDialog } from "@/components/FormDialog";
import { ListPending } from "@/components/ListPending";
import { TableMessage } from "@/components/TableMessage";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from "@/components/ui/native-select";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import {
  checkRuleForm,
  DEFAULT_WEIGHT,
  emptyRuleForm,
  isHard,
  isVmRule,
  RULE_KINDS,
  type RuleForm,
  ruleFormOf,
  ruleSpecOf,
  sameRuleSpec,
} from "@/placement/rules";

/** 배치 규칙: 목록과 만들기·바꾸기·지우기. 누구나 읽고 admin만 바꾼다. */
export function PlacementRulesPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const me = usePrincipal();
  const rules = useList("placement-rule");
  const nodes = useList("node");
  // 만들기는 `null`, 바꾸기는 그 규칙
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<PlacementRule | null | undefined>(undefined);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<PlacementRule | null>(null);
  const [deleteOpen, setDeleteOpen] = useState(false);
  const opener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const write = can(me.role, "write", "placement-rule");
  const list = [...(rules.data ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h1 id="placement-rules-title" className="text-2xl font-semibold">
          {t("nav.placementRules")}
        </h1>
        {write && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            {/* 노드 목록을 읽어야 규칙의 노드를 고른다. */}
            {!nodes.isSuccess && <ListPending error={nodes.error} />}
            <Button
              disabled={!nodes.isSuccess || !rules.isSuccess}
              onClick={(e) => {
                opener.current = e.currentTarget;
                setEditing(null);
              }}
            >
              <Plus />
              {t("common.create")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("placementRules.pageHint")}</p>
      <Table aria-labelledby="placement-rules-title">
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead>{t("common.name")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("placementRules.kind")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("placementRules.vms")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("placementRules.nodes")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("placementRules.weight")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead>{t("common.state")}</TableHead>
            {write && (
              <TableHead>
                <span className="sr-only">{t("vms.actions")}</span>
              </TableHead>
            )}
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {list.length === 0 && (
            <TableMessage colSpan={write ? 7 : 6} query={rules} empty={t("placementRules.empty")} />
          )}
          {list.map((rule) => {
            const s = rule.spec;
            return (
              <TableRow key={rule.id}>
                <TableCell className="font-medium">{rule.name}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{t(`placementRules.kinds.${s.kind}`)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {s.vm_tag != null ? (
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs">{s.vm_tag}</span>
                  ) : (
                    (s.vms ?? []).join(", ")
                  )}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {s.node_tag != null ? (
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs">{s.node_tag}</span>
                  ) : (
                    (s.nodes ?? []).join(", ") || "—"
                  )}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{isHard(s.kind) ? "—" : (s.weight ?? DEFAULT_WEIGHT)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                    <Badge variant={s.enabled ? "secondary" : "outline"}>
                      {t(
                        s.enabled
                          ? "placementRules.state.enabled"
                          : "placementRules.state.disabled",
                      )}
                    </Badge>
                    {s.ha_may_violate && (
                      <Badge variant="outline">{t("placementRules.haMayViolateShort")}</Badge>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                {write && (
                  <TableCell className="text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      aria-label={t("placementRules.editNamed", { name: rule.name })}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        opener.current = e.currentTarget;
                        setEditing(rule);
                      }}
                    >
                      <Pencil />
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      aria-label={t("placementRules.deleteNamed", { name: rule.name })}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        opener.current = e.currentTarget;
                        setDeleting(rule);
                        setDeleteOpen(true);
                      }}
                    >
                      <Trash2 />
                    </Button>
                  </TableCell>
                )}
              </TableRow>
            );
          })}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
      {editing !== undefined && (
        <RuleDialog
          rule={editing}
          taken={(rules.data ?? []).map((r) => r.name)}
          returnFocus={opener}
          onClose={() => setEditing(undefined)}
        />
      )}
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={deleteOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDeleteOpen}
        returnFocus={opener}
        title={t("placementRules.deleteTitle", { name: deleting?.name })}
        description={t("placementRules.deleteDescription")}
        confirmLabel={t("common.delete")}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          const rule = deleting!;
          await call(api.DELETE("/placement-rules/{key}", { params: { path: { key: rule.id } } }));
          toast.success(t("placementRules.deleted", { name: rule.name }));
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** 규칙 만들기(`rule`이 null)와 바꾸기. 열 때만 그린다. */
function RuleDialog({
  rule,
  taken,
  returnFocus,
  onClose,
}: {
  rule: PlacementRule | null;
  /** 있는 규칙 이름 */
  taken: string[];
  returnFocus: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  onClose(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  // 위트니스는 VM을 돌리지 않는다. 지운 노드가 규칙에 남아 있으면 그 이름도 보인다(서버가 저장할 때 거절한다).
  const names = (useList("node").data ?? []).filter((n) => !n.spec.witness).map((n) => n.name);
  for (const n of rule?.spec.nodes ?? []) {
    if (!names.includes(n)) {
      names.push(n);
    }
  }
  names.sort();
  const [form, setForm] = useState<RuleForm>(() => (rule ? ruleFormOf(rule) : emptyRuleForm()));
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const change = (part: Partial<RuleForm>) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, ...part }));
  const unchanged = rule !== null && sameRuleSpec(rule.spec, ruleSpecOf(form));
  const hard = isHard(form.kind);

  async function submit() {
    const found = checkRuleForm(form, rule ? null : taken);
    setErrors(found);
    if (Object.keys(found).length > 0) {
      return false;
    }
    if (rule) {
      await call(
        api.PUT("/placement-rules/{key}", {
          params: { path: { key: rule.id }, header: { "If-Match": rule.revision } },
          body: { labels: rule.labels, spec: ruleSpecOf(form) },
        }),
      );
      toast.success(t("placementRules.saved", { name: rule.name }));
    } else {
      await call(
        api.POST("/placement-rules", { body: { name: form.name, spec: ruleSpecOf(form) } }),
      );
      toast.success(t("placementRules.created", { name: form.name }));
    }
  }

  return (
    <FormDialog
      title={
        rule ? t("placementRules.editTitle", { name: rule.name }) : t("placementRules.createTitle")
      }
      description={t("placementRules.dialogDescription")}
      submitLabel={rule ? t("common.save") : t("common.create")}
      submitDisabled={unchanged}
      returnFocus={returnFocus}
      onClose={onClose}
      onSubmit={submit}
    >
      {!rule && (
        <Field id="rule-name" label={t("common.name")} error={errors.name}>
          {(a11y) => (
            <Input
              id="rule-name"
              value={form.name}
              onChange={(e) => change({ name: e.target.value })}
              {...a11y}
            />
          )}
        </Field>
      )}
      <Field
        id="rule-kind"
        label={t("placementRules.kind")}
        hint={t(`placementRules.kindHint.${form.kind}`)}
      >
        {(a11y) => (
          <NativeSelect
            id="rule-kind"
            className="w-full"
            value={form.kind}
            onChange={(e) => change({ kind: e.target.value as RuleKind })}
            {...a11y}
          >
            {RULE_KINDS.map((kind) => (
              <NativeSelectOption key={kind} value={kind}>
                {t(`placementRules.kinds.${kind}`)}
              </NativeSelectOption>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        )}
      </Field>
      <Field id="rule-vm-by" label={t("placementRules.vmBy")}>
        <NativeSelect
          id="rule-vm-by"
          className="w-full"
          value={form.vmBy}
          onChange={(e) => change({ vmBy: e.target.value as RuleForm["vmBy"] })}
        >
          <NativeSelectOption value="names">{t("placementRules.byNames")}</NativeSelectOption>
          <NativeSelectOption value="tag">{t("placementRules.byLabel")}</NativeSelectOption>
        </NativeSelect>
      </Field>
      {form.vmBy === "names" ? (
        <Field
          id="rule-vms"
          label={t("placementRules.vmNames")}
          error={errors.vms}
          hint={t("placementRules.vmNamesHint")}
        >
          {(a11y) => (
            <Input
              id="rule-vms"
              placeholder="web1, web2"
              value={form.vms}
              onChange={(e) => change({ vms: e.target.value })}
              {...a11y}
            />
          )}
        </Field>
      ) : (
        <Field
          id="rule-vm-tag"
          label={t("placementRules.vmTag")}
          error={errors.vms}
          hint={t("placementRules.vmTagHint")}
        >
          {(a11y) => (
            <Input
              id="rule-vm-tag"
              placeholder="app=web"
              value={form.vmTag}
              onChange={(e) => change({ vmTag: e.target.value })}
              {...a11y}
            />
          )}
        </Field>
      )}
      {!isVmRule(form.kind) && (
        <>
          <Field id="rule-node-by" label={t("placementRules.nodeBy")}>
            <NativeSelect
              id="rule-node-by"
              className="w-full"
              value={form.nodeBy}
              onChange={(e) => change({ nodeBy: e.target.value as RuleForm["nodeBy"] })}
            >
              <NativeSelectOption value="names">{t("placementRules.byNames")}</NativeSelectOption>
              <NativeSelectOption value="tag">{t("placementRules.byLabel")}</NativeSelectOption>
            </NativeSelect>
          </Field>
          {form.nodeBy === "names" ? (
            <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              <legend className="mb-1.5 text-sm font-medium">{t("placementRules.nodes")}</legend>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                {names.map((node) => (
                  <div key={node} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Checkbox
                      id={`rule-node-${node}`}
                      checked={form.nodes.includes(node)}
                      onCheckedChange={(on) =>
                        change({
                          nodes:
                            on === true
                              ? [...form.nodes, node]
                              : form.nodes.filter((n) => n !== node),
                        })
                      }
                    />
                    <Label htmlFor={`rule-node-${node}`}>{node}</Label>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              {errors.nodes && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{t(errors.nodes)}</p>}
            </fieldset>
          ) : (
            <Field
              id="rule-node-tag"
              label={t("placementRules.nodeTag")}
              error={errors.nodes}
              hint={t("placementRules.nodeTagHint")}
            >
              {(a11y) => (
                <Input
                  id="rule-node-tag"
                  placeholder="zone=rack-a"
                  value={form.nodeTag}
                  onChange={(e) => change({ nodeTag: e.target.value })}
                  {...a11y}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {!hard && (
        <Field
          id="rule-weight"
          label={t("placementRules.weight")}
          error={errors.weight}
          hint={t("placementRules.weightHint")}
        >
          {(a11y) => (
            <Input
              id="rule-weight"
              inputMode="numeric"
              placeholder={String(DEFAULT_WEIGHT)}
              value={form.weight}
              onChange={(e) => change({ weight: e.target.value })}
              {...a11y}
            />
          )}
        </Field>
      )}
      {hard && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Checkbox
              id="rule-ha-may-violate"
              checked={form.haMayViolate}
              onCheckedChange={(on) => change({ haMayViolate: on === true })}
            />
            <Label htmlFor="rule-ha-may-violate">{t("placementRules.haMayViolate")}</Label>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("placementRules.haMayViolateHint")}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Checkbox
          id="rule-enabled"
          checked={form.enabled}
          onCheckedChange={(on) => change({ enabled: on === true })}
        />
        <Label htmlFor="rule-enabled">{t("placementRules.enabled")}</Label>
      </div>
    </FormDialog>
  );
}
```

`web/src/placement/rules.ts`를 만든다:

```ts
import type { PlacementRule, RuleKind } from "@/api/types";
import { validName } from "@/vms/form";

type Spec = PlacementRule["spec"];

/** 화면에 보이는 순서: VM끼리 규칙, VM과 노드 규칙 */
export const RULE_KINDS: readonly RuleKind[] = [
  "affinity",
  "anti-affinity",
  "soft-affinity",
  "soft-anti-affinity",
  "node-affinity",
  "node-anti-affinity",
  "soft-node-affinity",
  "soft-node-anti-affinity",
];

/** 서버의 `MAX_WEIGHT`·`DEFAULT_WEIGHT` */
export const MAX_WEIGHT = 100;
export const DEFAULT_WEIGHT = 50;

/** 서버의 `RuleKind::is_hard`: `soft-`가 아니면 반드시 지키는 규칙 */
export function isHard(kind: RuleKind): boolean {
  return !kind.startsWith("soft-");
}

/** 서버의 `RuleKind::is_vm_rule`: VM끼리 규칙(노드를 주지 않는다) */
export function isVmRule(kind: RuleKind): boolean {
  return !kind.includes("node");
}

/** 서버의 `parse_tag`: `key=value`이고 key가 비지 않았는지 */
export function validTag(tag: string): boolean {
  const at = tag.indexOf("=");
  return at > 0;
}

function parseNames(text: string): string[] {
  return text
    .split(",")
    .map((n) => n.trim())
    .filter((n) => n !== "");
}

/** 만들기·바꾸기 폼의 값. 숫자도 입력 그대로 문자열로 둔다. */
export interface RuleForm {
  name: string;
  kind: RuleKind;
  /** VM을 이름(`names`)으로 고르는지 레이블(`tag`)로 고르는지 */
  vmBy: "names" | "tag";
  /** 쉼표로 나눈 VM 이름 */
  vms: string;
  vmTag: string;
  nodeBy: "names" | "tag";
  /** 고른 노드 이름 */
  nodes: string[];
  nodeTag: string;
  /** soft 규칙의 벌점. 비면 서버 기본(50)이다. */
  weight: string;
  haMayViolate: boolean;
  enabled: boolean;
}

export function emptyRuleForm(): RuleForm {
  return {
    name: "",
    kind: "anti-affinity",
    vmBy: "names",
    vms: "",
    vmTag: "",
    nodeBy: "names",
    nodes: [],
    nodeTag: "",
    weight: "",
    haMayViolate: false,
    enabled: true,
  };
}

export function ruleFormOf(rule: PlacementRule): RuleForm {
  const s = rule.spec;
  return {
    name: rule.name,
    kind: s.kind,
    vmBy: s.vm_tag != null ? "tag" : "names",
    vms: (s.vms ?? []).join(", "),
    vmTag: s.vm_tag ?? "",
    nodeBy: s.node_tag != null ? "tag" : "names",
    nodes: s.nodes ?? [],
    nodeTag: s.node_tag ?? "",
    weight: s.weight == null ? "" : String(s.weight),
    haMayViolate: s.ha_may_violate ?? false,
    enabled: s.enabled,
  };
}

/** 서버와 같은 검사. 오류는 필드별 번역 키다. `taken`은 다른 규칙의 이름이고 바꾸기면 null(이름 없음). */
export function checkRuleForm(form: RuleForm, taken: string[] | null): Record<string, string> {
  const found: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (taken !== null) {
    if (!validName(form.name)) {
      found.name = "forms.name";
    } else if (taken.includes(form.name)) {
      found.name = "placementRules.errors.exists";
    }
  }
  if (form.vmBy === "tag") {
    if (!validTag(form.vmTag.trim())) {
      found.vms = "placementRules.errors.tag";
    }
  } else {
    const names = parseNames(form.vms);
    if (names.length < (isVmRule(form.kind) ? 2 : 1)) {
      found.vms = isVmRule(form.kind)
        ? "placementRules.errors.twoVms"
        : "placementRules.errors.oneVm";
    } else if (names.some((n) => !validName(n)) || new Set(names).size !== names.length) {
      found.vms = "placementRules.errors.vmNames";
    }
  }
  if (!isVmRule(form.kind)) {
    if (form.nodeBy === "tag") {
      if (!validTag(form.nodeTag.trim())) {
        found.nodes = "placementRules.errors.tag";
      }
    } else if (form.nodes.length === 0) {
      found.nodes = "placementRules.errors.nodes";
    }
  }
  const weight = form.weight.trim();
  if (
    !isHard(form.kind) &&
    weight !== "" &&
    !(/^\d+$/.test(weight) && Number(weight) >= 1 && Number(weight) <= MAX_WEIGHT)
  ) {
    found.weight = "placementRules.errors.weight";
  }
  return found;
}

/** 검사한 폼의 스펙. 그 종류에 없는 값(VM끼리 규칙의 노드, hard 규칙의 벌점 등)은 빼고 보낸다. */
export function ruleSpecOf(form: RuleForm): Spec {
  const weight = form.weight.trim();
  return {
    kind: form.kind,
    ...(form.vmBy === "tag" ? { vm_tag: form.vmTag.trim() } : { vms: parseNames(form.vms) }),
    ...(!isVmRule(form.kind) &&
      (form.nodeBy === "tag"
        ? { node_tag: form.nodeTag.trim() }
        : { nodes: [...form.nodes].sort() })),
    ...(!isHard(form.kind) && weight !== "" && { weight: Number(weight) }),
    ...(isHard(form.kind) && form.haMayViolate && { ha_may_violate: true }),
    enabled: form.enabled,
  };
}

/** 같은 스펙인지(빠진 값과 기본값은 같게 본다). 바꾼 것이 없으면 저장 버튼을 막는다. */
export function sameRuleSpec(a: Spec, b: Spec): boolean {
  const norm = (s: Spec) =>
    JSON.stringify([
      s.kind,
      s.vms ?? [],
      s.vm_tag ?? null,
      [...(s.nodes ?? [])].sort(),
      s.node_tag ?? null,
      s.weight ?? null,
      s.ha_may_violate ?? false,
      s.enabled,
    ]);
  return norm(a) === norm(b);
}
```

```tsx
it("changes the shutdown policy and shows the default when none is saved", async () => {
  const sent: unknown[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.get(apiUrl("/settings"), () => HttpResponse.json(DEFAULT)),
    http.patch(apiUrl("/settings"), async ({ request }) => {
      const body = (await request.json()) as { shutdown_policy: string };
      sent.push(body);
      return HttpResponse.json({
        ...DEFAULT,
        revision: 4,
        spec: { ...DEFAULT.spec, shutdown_policy: body.shutdown_policy },
      });
    }),
  );
  renderPage(<SettingsPage />);
  const policy = await screen.findByLabelText("Policy");
  // 기본(conditional)은 저장하지 않으므로 없으면 기본이다.
  expect(policy).toHaveValue("conditional");
  expect(screen.getByText("Freeze on reboot, fail over on power off.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  const save = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save policy" });
  expect(save).toBeDisabled();
  await userEvent.selectOptions(policy, "migrate");
  await userEvent.click(save);
  await vi.waitFor(() => expect(sent).toEqual([{ shutdown_policy: "migrate" }]));
  // 응답을 바로 보여 준다.
  await vi.waitFor(() =>
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save policy" })).toBeDisabled(),
  );
  expect(screen.getByLabelText("Policy")).toHaveValue("migrate");
});

it("says the cluster is upgrading when old nodes do not know shutdown policies", async () => {
  server.use(
    http.get(apiUrl("/settings"), () => HttpResponse.json(DEFAULT)),
    http.patch(apiUrl("/settings"), () =>
      HttpResponse.json(
        { code: "cluster_upgrading", message: "node n2 does not support ha-placement yet" },
        { status: 409 },
      ),
    ),
  );
  renderPage(<SettingsPage />);
  await userEvent.selectOptions(await screen.findByLabelText("Policy"), "freeze");
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save policy" }));
  expect(await screen.findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent(
    "The cluster is being upgraded: node n2 does not support ha-placement yet",
  );
});
```

```tsx
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { useSettings } from "@/api/live";
import type { ShutdownPolicy } from "@/api/types";
import { Field } from "@/components/Field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from "@/components/ui/native-select";
import { patchSettings, settingsError } from "@/settings/save";

const POLICIES: ShutdownPolicy[] = ["conditional", "freeze", "failover", "migrate"];

/** 노드 정상 종료 정책: 호스트가 재부팅하거나 꺼질 때 그 노드의 HA VM을 어떻게 할지. */
export function ShutdownSection({ write }: { write: boolean }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const settings = useSettings();
  // 고르기 전에는 서버의 값을 보인다(watch로 바뀌어도 따라간다).
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<ShutdownPolicy | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!settings.data) {
    return null;
  }
  // 기본(conditional)은 저장하지 않으므로 없으면 기본이다.
  const current = settings.data.spec.shutdown_policy ?? "conditional";
  const policy = chosen ?? current;
  const revision = settings.data.revision;

  async function save(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await patchSettings(queryClient, revision, { shutdown_policy: policy });
      setChosen(null);
      toast.success(t("settings.saved"));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(settingsError(t, err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(e) => void save(e)} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <h2 className="font-medium">{t("settings.shutdown.title")}</h2>
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <Field
        id="settings-shutdown-policy"
        label={t("settings.shutdown.policy")}
        hint={t(`settings.shutdown.hint.${policy}`)}
      >
        {(a11y) => (
          <NativeSelect
            id="settings-shutdown-policy"
            value={policy}
            disabled={!write || busy}
            onChange={(e) => setChosen(e.target.value as ShutdownPolicy)}
            {...a11y}
          >
            {POLICIES.map((p) => (
              <NativeSelectOption key={p} value={p}>
                {t(`settings.shutdown.policies.${p}`)}
              </NativeSelectOption>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        )}
      </Field>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("settings.shutdown.note")}</p>
      {write && (
        <div>
          <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={busy || policy === current}>
            {t("settings.shutdown.save")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** HA 가능 노드의 멈춘 VM app을 편집하는 화면. 보낸 본문을 모은다. */
function editStoppedApp() {
  mockLists({ vm: [vm("app", "stopped")], node: [FENCED], "ha-group": [haGroup("rack", 1)] });
  const bodies: { spec: { ha: unknown } }[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.put(apiUrl(`/vms/${vm("app", "stopped").id}`), async ({ request }) => {
      bodies.push((await request.json()) as (typeof bodies)[number]);
      return HttpResponse.json(vm("app", "stopped"));
    }),
  );
  renderPage(<VmEditPage />, { path: "/vms/:name/edit", url: "/vms/app/edit" });
  return bodies;
}

it("sends the default HA policy as the old true", async () => {
  const bodies = editStoppedApp();
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  // 정책의 값은 HA를 켤 때만 보인다.
  expect(screen.queryByLabelText("HA state")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole("switch", { name: "High availability (HA)" }));
  expect(screen.getByLabelText("HA state")).toHaveValue("started");
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(bodies).toHaveLength(1));
  // 기본 정책은 옛 모양 그대로다(옛 노드가 남아도 저장된다).
  expect(bodies[0]?.spec.ha).toBe(true);
});

it("sets the HA state, group and counts", async () => {
  const bodies = editStoppedApp();
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole("switch", { name: "High availability (HA)" }));
  await user.selectOptions(screen.getByLabelText("HA state"), "stopped");
  await user.selectOptions(await screen.findByLabelText("HA group"), "rack");
  const restarts = screen.getByLabelText("Restarts on the same node");
  await user.clear(restarts);
  await user.type(restarts, "11");
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  expect(screen.getByText("From 0 to 10.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  await user.clear(restarts);
  await user.type(restarts, "3");
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(bodies).toHaveLength(1));
  expect(bodies[0]?.spec.ha).toEqual({
    state: "stopped",
    group: "rack",
    max_restart: 3,
    max_relocate: 1,
  });
});

it("keeps the HA policy of a VM when other fields change", async () => {
  const policy = { state: "stopped", group: "gone", max_restart: 0, max_relocate: 2 } as const;
  const app = vm("app", "stopped", { spec: { ...vm("app", "stopped").spec, ha: policy } });
  mockLists({ vm: [app], node: [FENCED] });
  let body: { spec: { ha: unknown; memory_mib: number } } | undefined;
  server.use(
    http.put(apiUrl(`/vms/${app.id}`), async ({ request }) => {
      body = (await request.json()) as typeof body;
      return HttpResponse.json(app);
    }),
  );
  renderPage(<VmEditPage />, { path: "/vms/:name/edit", url: "/vms/app/edit" });
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  // 지운 그룹도 고른 값으로 보인다.
  expect(await screen.findByLabelText("HA group")).toHaveValue("gone");
  const memory = screen.getByLabelText("Memory (MiB)");
  await user.clear(memory);
  await user.type(memory, "4096");
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(body?.spec.memory_mib).toBe(4096));
  expect(body?.spec.ha).toEqual(policy);
});

it("keeps a running VM with ignored HA from activating HA", async () => {
  const policy = { state: "ignored", max_restart: 1, max_relocate: 1 } as const;
  const app = vm("app", "running", { spec: { ...vm("app", "running").spec, ha: policy } });
  mockLists({ vm: [app], node: [FENCED] });
  renderPage(<VmEditPage />, { path: "/vms/:name/edit", url: "/vms/app/edit" });
  const state = await screen.findByLabelText("HA state");
  expect(state).toHaveValue("ignored");
  expect(within(state).getByRole("option", { name: "Started" })).toBeDisabled();
  expect(within(state).getByRole("option", { name: "Ignored (paused)" })).toBeEnabled();
  expect(screen.getByText("Turn on HA while the VM is stopped.")).toHaveClass(
    "text-muted-foreground",
  );
});
```
